items.title: Nulliparity modifies the maternal genetic effects on gestational duration but not on birth weight
items.abstract: Gestational duration and birth weight are linked to both short- and long-term adverse health outcomes in mothers and their offspring. Previous genome-wide association studies on these pregnancy outcomes have been successful but have overlooked the number of a mother's previous pregnancies. In this study, we explored if parity (the number of children a mother has previously delivered) modifies the maternal or foetal genetic effect of gestational duration and birth weight (gene x parity interactions) using data from the Norwegian Mother, Father, and Child Cohort Study in up to 58,528 mothers and their offspring. Potential genetic effect differences were investigated by: (1) performing parity-stratified genome-wide association studies, (2) testing SNP x parity interactions, (3) testing the interaction between a polygenic prediction of the traits and parity, and (4) assessing the genetic correlation within each outcome across parity. For both phenotypes, we identified shared and distinct loci for each outcome in terms both of genetic region and number in the parity-stratified genome-wide association studies, and the genetic correlation by parity deviated from one for all outcomes. The strongest evidence of genetic modification effect by parity was found for gestational duration in the maternal genome where genetic effects were stronger in the first pregnancy compared to later pregnancies. For instance, the polygenic prediction of the maternal genome on gestational duration had a significant interaction with parity (p-value interaction = 5 x 10-5). The results for birth weight were more uncertain, suggesting that the identified gene x parity interactions is largely limited to gestational duration. In conclusion, our study reveals that parity modifies the genetic effects on gestational duration and highlights the relevance of considering parity in genetic studies on pregnancy outcomes.
items.authors: Ytterberg, K.; Sundelin, H.; Wu, X.; Juodakis, J.; Vaudel, M.; Corfield, E. C.; Andreassen, O. A.; Magnus, P.; Havdahl, A.; Nilsson, S.; Njolstad, P. R.; Johansson, S.; Jacobsson, B.; Sole-Navais, P.

items.title: Integrating Causal Inference into Pharmacovigilance: Target Trial Emulations for Proactive Signal Detection of Atorvastatin Initiation in Medicare Beneficiaries
items.abstract: Importance: Adverse drug events (ADEs) in older adults are a substantial public health burden, yet spontaneous reporting systems detect them poorly owing to underreporting and the lack of a defined population. These limitations are of particular concern for older adults, who are underrepresented in pre-approval trials yet at elevated ADE risk owing to polypharmacy, multimorbidity, and age-related changes in drug metabolism. Objective: To develop and apply an active, claims-based pharmacovigilance framework using sequential target trial emulation to detect ADE signals in older adults, with atorvastatin as the initial application. Methods: Using Medicare fee-for-service claims (2017-2019), we studied statin-naive beneficiaries aged 65 years or older following hospitalization for myocardial or cerebral infarction. We emulated up to 14 daily sequential trials from the discharge date, classifying patients as initiating atorvastatin (A1), initiating a different medication (A2), or no new medication (A0); the primary contrast was A1 versus A2. For each trial, incident ADEs were ascertained and classified into 552 outcomes based on the Clinical Classifications Software Refined categories. Per-protocol effect estimates were measured over a 6-month follow-up period using Fine-Gray regression weighted by the inverse probability of treatment (IPT) and censoring, treating death as a competing risk, with the false discovery rate controlled via the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure. A signal was declared when the q-value was [ ] 0.10 and the subdistribution hazard ratio (sHR) was [ ] 1.20 in any prespecified analytic stratum (sensitivity analyses used thresholds of q [ ] 0.20 and sHR [ ] 1.20). Results: Of 70,130 eligible patients, 39,948 initiated atorvastatin (A1), 19,182 initiated another new medication (A2); after IPT-weighting, baseline characteristics were closely balanced. After excluding outcomes with sparse cell counts, 295 outcomes were analyzed; five met the primary signal detection criteria: valve disorders (sHR 1.71, 1.20-2.43); sprains and strains (sHR 1.79, 1.26-2.54); general sensation/perception symptoms (sHR 1.23, 95% CI 1.11-1.36); abnormal findings without diagnosis (sHR 1.55, 1.18-2.05); and prediabetes (sHR 1.71, 1.24-2.36). In the sensitivity analysis, we additionally detected: posthemorrhagic anemia, hemorrhagic stroke, varicose veins, other circulatory and skin conditions. Conclusions: A claims-based framework using sequential target trial emulations detected both expected and previously unrecognized ADE signals following atorvastatin initiation in older adults, offering a systematic alternative to passive surveillance that can be extended to other commonly prescribed medications. Confirmatory analyses with disaggregated outcomes and narrower comparators are underway and will be reported separately.
items.authors: Rowan, C. G.; Tazare, J.; Donneyong, M. M.; Tran, M.; Srivastava, S.; Dreyer, N. A.; Maringe, C.
items.title_zh: 将因果推断整合入药物监测：阿托伐他汀启动的目标试验模拟
items.summary_zh: 重要性：老年人不良药物事件（ADEs）对公共健康构成重大负担，然而自发报告系统因报告不足和缺乏明确人群而难以有效检测。这些局限性在老年人中尤为突出，他们在批准前试验中代表性不足，但因多重用药、多重疾病和与年龄相关的药物代谢变化而面临更高的ADE风险。目的：开发并应用基于索赔的主动药物监测框架，通过顺序目标试验模拟检测老年人中的ADE信号，以阿托伐他汀为初步应用。方法：利用2017-2019年医疗保险按服务收费索赔数据，我们研究了65岁及以上的初次使用他汀类药物的受益者，研究对象为心肌梗死或脑梗死住院后的患者。我们模拟了出院日期起最多14天的顺序试验，将患者分类为启动阿托伐他汀（A1）、启动其他药物（A2）或未用新药（A0）；主要对比为A1与A2。每个试验中，事件ADEs被确认并根据临床分类软件精细分类为552个结果。通过Fine-Gray回归，使用治疗的逆概率加权和审查，测量6个月随访期内的协议效应估计。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，基于索赔的主动药物监测框架能够有效检测老年人中阿托伐他汀引发的不良药物事件信号，填补了传统报告系统的不足。
items.l2_summary:
老年人不良药物事件（ADEs）对公共健康构成了重大负担，尤其是在老年人群体中，由于他们在药物批准前的临床试验中代表性不足，加之多重用药和与年龄相关的药物代谢变化，使得他们面临更高的ADE风险。然而，现有的自发报告系统因报告不足和缺乏明确的人群定义，难以有效检测ADEs。为了解决这一问题，本研究旨在开发并应用基于索赔的主动药物监测框架，通过顺序目标试验模拟来检测老年人中的ADE信号，以阿托伐他汀（Atorvastatin）为初步应用对象。

研究利用2017年至2019年间的医疗保险按服务收费索赔数据，重点关注65岁及以上的初次使用他汀类药物的受益者，特别是那些在心肌梗死或脑梗死住院后的患者。研究设计模拟了出院日期起最多14天的顺序试验，将患者分为三组：启动阿托伐他汀（A1）、启动其他药物（A2）或未用新药（A0），主要对比为A1与A2。每个试验中，ADE事件被确认并根据临床分类软件精细分类为552个结果。通过Fine-Gray回归分析，结合治疗的逆概率加权和审查，研究测量了在6个月随访期内的协议效应估计。

本研究的结果表明，整合因果推断方法到药物监测中，能够有效识别老年人群体中的ADE信号，尤其是在阿托伐他汀的使用中。通过这种主动监测框架，能够更好地理解药物对老年患者的影响，从而为公共健康政策的制定提供科学依据，减少老年人群体中的不良药物事件发生率。

items.title: Matched liver-serum multi-omics and genetic risk reveal hepatic compartmentalization of metabolic disease in severe obesity
items.abstract: We profiled the hepatic transcriptome, lipidome and metabolome and serum metabolome in 211 MAFALDA participants with severe obesity undergoing bariatric surgery with liver biopsy. In 187 participants with paired samples, liver and serum levels of 40 matched metabolites correlated weakly (median {rho} 0.02), and steatosis and lobular inflammation were associated with 116 and 216 of 701 he-patic but [ ]1 of 653 serum metabolites. Hepatic amino acids were lower with lobular inflammation without serum changes, independently of tissue fat, dilution and glycemia, but largely shared with stea-tosis. Serum added little to clinical discrimination of steatosis (area under the curve 0.73 to 0.75) and nothing for inflammation, steatohepatitis or fibrosis. A polygenic score for hepatic lipid retention was associated with higher hepatic but lower serum triglycerides; its effects on inflammation and steatohepa-titis were largely mediated by liver fat. Circulating metabolites should be validated against histology, not interpreted as direct measures of hepatic metabolism.
items.authors: Gupta, S.; Jamialahmadi, O.; Mancina, R. M.; Duberg, D.; Vespasiani Gentilucci, U.; Tavaglione, F.; Bruni, V.; Tuccinardi, D.; Hyoetylaeinen, T.; Romeo, S.; Oresic, M.

items.title: Associations between motor and executive/attentional deficits in cerebral palsy: Scoping review
items.abstract: Background: Cerebral palsy (CP) is the leading cause of motor disability in children and is frequently accompanied by cognitive impairments, including deficits in executive and attentional functions. Despite growing research on motor-cognitive interactions in other populations, evidence in CP remains limited. Objective: To identify gaps in the current literature, this review synthesised evidence on the relationships between specific motor and executive/attentional functions in CP. Method: A systematic search of three databases was conducted. Articles were screened using predefined eligibility criteria by two independent assessors. The results were summarised in tables and narrative form. The review was written in accordance with the JBI Guidelines. Results: Thirteen articles were included in the review, spanning 652 participants aged between 22 months and 62 years. Five studies reported significant links of motor functions with executive functions, and five with attentional functions. Gross and fine motor skills were most reliably linked to working memory, fine motor skills to overall executive functioning, and gross motor skills to focused attention. Three studies found no evidence of links between motor and cognitive control domains. We include an overview of tools used for measuring motor and attention/executive functions in the reviewed studies. Conclusions: Our review suggests positive associations between motor and executive/attentional functions in individuals with CP, highlighting their interdependence. More longitudinal empirical studies are needed, to confirm these links, which will help design better interventions. Despite the still limited evidence, our findings and anecdotal clinical reports call for intervention studies evaluating the multidimensional, cross-domain functional improvements.
items.authors: Martinet, M.; Reichert, K.; Schneider, J.; Zhang, D.; Marschik, P. B.; Matusz, P. J.

items.title: Development and evaluation of a method for classifying foods to be consumed in moderation
items.abstract: Background: While the 2020-2025 Dietary Guidelines for Americans (DGA) recommend limiting foods high in added sugars, saturated fat, refined grains, and sodium, they do not provide criteria for classifying foods high in these components. Objective: To develop and evaluate quantitative criteria for classifying moderation foods informed by the DGA. Design: The 2017-2018 Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies (FNDDS, n=6909 foods) was used to evaluate food-level content validity, by examining the proportion of moderation foods within recommended and non-recommended food groups, and convergent validity, by comparing nutrient density in moderation versus non-moderation foods. Dietary recall data from the cross-sectional, nationally representative National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (2017-2018) were used to assess diet-level convergent validity, by investigating correlations of moderation food intake (% kcal) with overall diet quality. Participants/Setting: Participants in the U.S. aged 2+ years (n=6180) were included. Main outcome measures: The Nutrient Rich Foods 9.3 index (NRF) measured food-level nutrient density; Healthy Eating Index-2020 scores (HEI) measured person-level diet quality. Statistical Analyses: T-tests and ANOVA evaluated differences in nutrient density by moderation food classification. Pearson's correlations estimated associations of moderation food intake (% kcal) with HEI. Results: More non-recommended (e.g., 97% of snacks, 96% of sweets) than recommended (e.g., 19% of vegetables, 23% of fruits) food groups were classified as moderation foods. Mean nutrient density was significantly lower in moderation foods than non-moderation foods (mean difference in NRF scores = -74.8, p<0.001). Moderation food intake (% kcal) was negatively correlated with HEI (r=-0.72), HEI-moderation (r=-0.56), and HEI-adequacy (r=-0.67). Conclusions: The moderation food classification method demonstrated strong content and convergent validity, and may facilitate diet quality assessment, surveillance, and public health interventions.
items.authors: Channell Doig, A. J.; Lipsky, L. M.; Choe, A.; Nansel, T. R.

items.title: Developing an OMOP-Standardized Prostate Cancer Database and Improving Data Quality Using NLP and PSA-Based Algorithms
items.abstract: Objective: To develop and evaluate an Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) standardized prostate cancer database from the University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB) Epic Electronic Health Record (EHR) and improve data quality using natural language processing (NLP) and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) based algorithms. Materials and Methods: We built a data pipeline to transform UTMB Epic EHR data from 2010 to 2021 into OMOP Common Data Model (CDM) v5.4. Data quality was assessed by comparing the OMOP-standardized data with Galveston Cancer Registry data using availability agreement, Cohen's kappa, and Intraclass Correlation Coefficient. NLP was used to extract PSA, Gleason score, and cancer stage from clinical text, and PSA-based algorithms were used to identify missing treatment and biochemical recurrence. Results: We extracted 815 analytic cases from UTMB EHR. Among them, 700, or 85.9%, were complete and concordant with the cancer registry. PSA showed excellent value agreement. Structured Gleason score and stage data were sparse, with fewer than 20 cases, but NLP greatly improved capture. Treatment agreement was good compared with the cancer registry and improved slightly for radical prostatectomy after applying a PSA-based algorithm. Using PSA trajectories, we identified 60 cases of biochemical recurrence. Discussion: The OMOP-standardized data from UTMB showed good agreement with the cancer registry. However, structured EHR fields incompletely captured diagnosis, pathology, and treatment details. NLP and PSA-based algorithms substantially improved data capture. Manual review also revealed errors in registry data, showing that OMOP-standardized EHR data can complement and help improve cancer registry quality. Conclusion: OMOP standardization combined with NLP and PSA-based algorithms improved prostate cancer data quality and research readiness.
items.authors: Wang, J.; Jackson, J. C.; Garza, A.; Nalla, S.; Ninnemann, T.; Zhang, Y.; Kuo, Y.-F.

items.title: Deep Learning Trained Without Target-Domain Labels Improves Risk Stratification Over Expert Coronary Calcium Reading on Routine Attenuation Correction CT
items.abstract: Coronary artery calcium (CAC) is an established measure of coronary atherosclerosis on computed tomography (CT). Many SPECT and most PET myocardial perfusion studies already include a low-dose CT scan from which coronary calcium could be reported, yet it almost never is. CAC may not be reported due to image noise, cardiac motion, or the absence of a reliable reference standard. Deep learning (DL) models trained on these low-dose CT scans inherit the same uncertainty, because their reference labels are drawn on the degraded images. We bypassed this limitation by training a DL CAC model entirely outside the target domain: expert labels from high-quality gated CT were inherited by synthetic ungated images derived from those same scans, so that no CTAC scan was annotated, and no real CTAC image was used, at any point in training. Models were trained using one center and externally tested in two other centers. Because each synthetic image is derived from the gated scan itself, expert gated segmentations remain valid voxel-for-voxel without registration. Using these pairs, we developed a cross-domain knowledge adaptation model (knowledge adaptation, KAD-CAC). The DL models were externally tested on 5969 patients with a median age of 64 (IQR 56 - 73), of whom 50.2% were male. The KAD-CAC model had higher Cohens kappa K (0.86, 95% CI 0.84 - 0.88) compared to a convolutional LSTM model (K 0.78, 95% CI 0.76 - 0.80, p<0.01), or models trained with only gated images (K 0.81, 95% CI 0.80 - 0.82, p<0.01). Net reclassification improvement for death or myocardial infarction over a clinical and perfusion baseline was greatest for the KAD-CAC model and exceeded that of expert CAC reading on the same CTAC scans (difference 0.089, 95% CI 0.051 to 0.125, p<0.001). A model trained without any labels from CTAC scans therefore stratified risk of death or MI better than expert reading of the same scans. Patients classified as CAC 0 by KAD-CAC had lower adjusted risk of death or MI than patients classified as CAC 0 by experts (HR 0.50, 95% CI 0.25 - 0.98). We use paired synthetic ungated scans to transfer expert gated CAC annotations into the ungated domain, resulting in better vessel-level CAC scoring and improved risk reclassification compared with expert reading of the same scans. Automated CAC scoring could be added to every myocardial perfusion imaging report without additional imaging or radiation. The approach provides a general route to expert-quality supervision for any acquisition in which the native reference standard is unreliable.
items.authors: Shanbhag, A.; Miller, R. J.; Killekar, A.; Marcinkiewicz, A. M.; Zhou, J.; Lemley, M.; Kamagate, A.; Van Kriekinge, S. D.; Kavanagh, P. B.; Feher, A.; Miller, E. J.; Liang, J. X.; Berman, D. S.; Dey, D.; Leahy, R. M.; Slomka, P.

items.title: Quantifying the genetic separability of disease subtypes
items.abstract: Genetic prediction of clinically defined disease subtypes could advance precision medicine, but polygenic risk scores (PRSs) often show limited ability to distinguish subtypes, either because the subtypes share genetic architecture or because available PRSs are inaccurate. We introduce GenSep, a statistical framework that estimates the oracle case-case AUC attainable if the true additive genetic values of both subtypes were known, and the proportion of this genetic separation recovered by subtype-specific PRSs. Across 18 subtype pairs in UK Biobank, oracle AUCs ranged from 0.605 to 1.000, whereas current PRSs achieved a median observed case-case AUC of only 0.530 (range, 0.510-0.754), corresponding to recovery of a median of 4.1% (range, 0.3-15.5%) of the genetic separation variance available to a perfect predictor. Oracle AUCs were generally consistent across UK Biobank, All of Us, FinnGen and the Million Veteran Program, and across European, African and Admixed American ancestry groups. FinnGen-trained PRSs, despite 2.6- to 3.9-fold larger discovery samples, performed no better than internally trained PRSs, and substantially larger consortium GWAS raised case-case AUC by 0.06 on average (range, 0.003-0.089). GenSep separates subtype pairs limited by intrinsic genetic overlap from those limited by current PRS accuracy, identifying where larger studies and better predictors could improve genetic discrimination.
items.authors: Ning, C.; Hof, J.; Speed, D.

items.title: Linear NeuroPaint: An Efficient Baseline for Cross-Session Neural Alignment and Inpainting
items.abstract: Large-scale Neuropixels recordings sample many brain areas, but no single experimental session records every area of interest. NeuroPaint, a transformer-based autoencoder, integrates such recordings by aligning area-specific latent dynamics across sessions and "inpainting" activity in unrecorded areas. Could a linear model, which would be computationally efficient and potentially more interpretable, suffice to achieve this? To address this question, we introduce Linear NeuroPaint, a linear variant of NeuroPaint, and evaluate it on two multi-area Neuropixels datasets. Linear NeuroPaint achieves strong predictive performance on recorded areas, however, it is less accurate than nonlinear models at cross-area inpainting, despite extensive hyperparameter optimization. Moreover, its parameters are not readily interpretable: incomplete cross-session alignment leads parameter-defined neuron clusters to exhibit heterogeneous response profiles. Together, these results show that linear transformations are insufficient for cross-session alignment and cross-area prediction. Nevertheless, Linear NeuroPaint provides a computationally efficient baseline for benchmarking multi-session neural models.
items.authors: Yao, Y. J.; Xia, J.; Paninski, L.; Miller, K. D.
items.title_zh: 线性神经绘画：跨会话神经对齐与填充的高效基线
items.summary_zh: 大规模Neuropixels记录涵盖多个脑区，但单次实验无法记录所有感兴趣区域。NeuroPaint是一种基于变换器的自编码器，通过对齐特定区域的潜在动态并在未记录区域进行“填充”来整合这些记录。为探讨线性模型是否足够有效，我们提出了线性神经绘画（Linear NeuroPaint），并在两个多区域Neuropixels数据集上进行评估。线性神经绘画在记录区域表现出强大的预测性能，但在跨区域填充方面的准确性低于非线性模型，尽管进行了广泛的超参数优化。此外，其参数不易解释：不完整的跨会话对齐导致参数定义的神经元簇表现出异质的响应特征。这些结果表明，线性变换不足以实现跨会话对齐和跨区域预测。然而，线性神经绘画为多会话神经模型提供了一个计算高效的基线。
items.l1_lead: 线性神经绘画在多区域Neuropixels数据集上表现出良好的预测性能，但在跨区域填充准确性上不及非线性模型，显示线性变换不足以实现有效的跨会话对齐。
items.l2_summary: 本研究探讨了线性神经绘画（Linear NeuroPaint）在多区域Neuropixels数据集上的应用，旨在评估其在跨会话神经对齐与填充中的有效性。由于大规模Neuropixels记录无法在单次实验中覆盖所有感兴趣的脑区，NeuroPaint作为一种基于变换器的自编码器，能够通过对齐特定区域的潜在动态并在未记录区域进行“填充”来整合这些记录。研究发现，线性神经绘画在记录区域的预测性能表现强劲，但在跨区域填充的准确性上却低于非线性模型，尽管进行了广泛的超参数优化。这一结果表明，线性变换在实现跨会话对齐和跨区域预测方面存在不足。此外，线性神经绘画的参数解释性较差，部分原因在于不完整的跨会话对齐导致参数定义的神经元簇表现出异质的响应特征。综上所述，尽管线性神经绘画未能在所有方面超越非线性模型，但它为多会话神经模型提供了一个计算高效的基线，具有一定的研究价值。

items.title: Scalable methylome-transcriptome profiling resolves clonal organization in human hematopoiesis
items.abstract: Understanding human tissue maintenance and remodeling requires linking clonal ancestry to molecular state, yet scalable joint measurement remains challenging. Here, we introduce Droplet-MT and an integrated computational workflow for joint transcriptome and methylome profiling at ~10,000 cells per library. Methylation epimutations enable mutation-independent clonal reconstruction from high-coverage methylomes, while reference-based label transfer assigns cells to established clones at ~0.2% CpG coverage, reducing sequencing cost. Clone-aggregated somatic variants provide genetic annotation without additional single-cell genotyping. Across ~21,000 paired profiles from healthy blood and longitudinal acute myeloid leukemia, we resolved small and expanded clones with heterogeneous lineage output. In leukemia, the framework distinguished changes in malignant clonal abundance, state remodeling within persistent clones, and recovery of healthy polyclonal hematopoiesis. Malignant monocytes remained transcriptionally and epigenetically distinct from healthy and recovery-associated cells despite treatment-associated remodeling. Droplet-MT enables scalable analysis of human tissues by linking clonal organization with molecular state and retrospective genetic annotation.
items.authors: Shao, J.; Chen, M.; Liu, Y.; Sun, J.; Zhang, G.; Yan, Z.-Y.; Lin, H.; Ren, M.; Pei, S.; Peng, J.; Gong, Y.; WANG, S.
items.title_zh: 可扩展的甲基组-转录组分析揭示人类造血的克隆组织
items.summary_zh: 理解人类组织的维持与重塑需要将克隆谱系与分子状态联系起来，但可扩展的联合测量仍然具有挑战性。本文介绍了Droplet-MT及其集成计算工作流程，能够在每个文库中对约10,000个细胞进行联合转录组和甲基组分析。甲基化表观突变使得从高覆盖率甲基组中进行独立于突变的克隆重建成为可能，而基于参考的标签转移在约0.2% CpG覆盖率下将细胞分配到已建立的克隆，从而降低测序成本。克隆聚合的体细胞变异提供了遗传注释，无需额外的单细胞基因分型。在来自健康血液和纵向急性髓性白血病的约21,000对样本中，我们解析了具有异质谱系输出的小型和扩展克隆。在白血病中，该框架区分了恶性克隆丰度的变化、持久克隆内的状态重塑以及健康多克隆造血的恢复。尽管经历了治疗相关的重塑，恶性单核细胞在转录组和表观遗传上仍与健康和恢复相关细胞显著不同。Droplet-MT通过将克隆组织与分子状态和回顾性遗传注释联系起来，实现了人类组织的可扩展分析。
items.l1_lead: Droplet-MT技术通过联合转录组和甲基组分析，揭示了人类造血中的克隆组织及其在健康与白血病状态下的差异，为理解组织维持与重塑提供了新方法。
items.l2_summary:
理解人类组织的维持与重塑需要将克隆谱系与分子状态相结合，但实现可扩展的联合测量仍然面临挑战。为此，研究团队开发了Droplet-MT及其集成计算工作流程，能够在每个文库中对约10,000个细胞进行联合转录组（transcriptome）和甲基组（methylome）分析。该方法利用甲基化表观突变，使得从高覆盖率甲基组中独立于突变进行克隆重建成为可能。同时，基于参考的标签转移技术在约0.2%的CpG（胞嘧啶-鸟嘌呤）覆盖率下，将细胞分配到已建立的克隆，从而有效降低了测序成本。

在对来自健康血液和纵向急性髓性白血病（acute myeloid leukemia, AML）的约21,000对样本进行分析时，研究揭示了具有异质谱系输出的小型和扩展克隆。在白血病样本中，该框架能够区分恶性克隆丰度的变化、持久克隆内的状态重塑，以及健康多克隆造血的恢复。尽管经历了治疗相关的重塑，恶性单核细胞在转录组和表观遗传层面上仍与健康和恢复相关细胞显著不同。这一发现表明，Droplet-MT通过将克隆组织与分子状态及回顾性遗传注释相结合，实现了对人类组织的可扩展分析，为理解人类造血的克隆组织提供了新的视角和方法。

items.title: An iPSC-based experimental framework for investigating phenotypic variation associated with Jomon ancestry in the present-day Japanese population
items.abstract: Ancestry-related genomic variation may contribute to phenotypic diversity. However, its cellular consequences remain difficult to evaluate. To address this, we developed a human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-based framework for investigating such phenotypes. We used the Japanese population as a model of Jomon-related and continental East Asian ancestry admixture. Jomon ancestry, estimated using the Jomon allele score (JAS), was associated with clinical measures, including renal-related traits and serum triglycerides in 34,152 Tohoku Medical Megabank participants. Peripheral blood mononuclear cell transcriptomics of donors from the upper and lower extremes of the JAS distribution (n = 10) suggested group-level differences in immune-related gene expression. To test whether the serum triglyceride association coincided with hepatic cellular phenotypes, we differentiated hiPSCs from these donors into hepatocyte-like cells. Neither intracellular triglycerides nor lipid-related gene expression differed between groups. These findings highlight the value of a genetically characterized hiPSC-based framework for investigating ancestry-associated phenotypes across cellular contexts.
items.authors: Nakamura, Y.; Watanabe, Y.; Tanabe, H.; Hirai, A.; Higashi, K.; Kurokawa, K.; Toyoda, A.; Kato, T.; Tsukahara, M.; Koganebuchi, K.; Hamazaki, Y.; Takebe, T.; Imamura, M.; Ishida, T.; Ohashi, J.; Oota, H.
items.title_zh: 基于iPSC的实验框架研究现代日本人群的縄文祖先表型变异
items.summary_zh: 祖先相关的基因组变异可能影响表型多样性，但其细胞后果仍难以评估。为此，我们开发了一种基于人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）的框架，以研究这种表型。我们以日本人群作为縄文相关与大陆东亚祖先混合的模型。通过縄文等位基因评分（JAS）估算的縄文祖先与34,152名东北医疗大银行参与者的临床指标（包括肾脏相关特征和血清甘油三酯）相关。对JAS分布上下极端捐赠者的外周血单核细胞转录组分析（n = 10）显示免疫相关基因表达存在组间差异。为了测试血清甘油三酯的关联是否与肝细胞表型一致，我们将这些捐赠者的hiPSC分化为肝细胞样细胞。组间的细胞内甘油三酯和脂质相关基因表达没有差异。这些发现突显了基于基因特征的hiPSC框架在不同细胞环境中研究祖先相关表型的价值。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，基于人类诱导多能干细胞的框架能够有效评估日本人群中縄文祖先基因变异对表型多样性的影响，尤其在免疫相关基因表达方面。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨祖先相关基因组变异对现代日本人群表型多样性的影响，特别是縄文祖先与大陆东亚祖先的混合对表型的潜在作用。为此，研究团队开发了一种基于人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）的实验框架，以便更好地评估这些基因变异的细胞后果。研究中，研究者们通过縄文等位基因评分（JAS）对34,152名东北医疗大银行参与者的临床指标进行了分析，发现縄文祖先的基因与肾脏相关特征及血清甘油三酯水平存在显著关联。

在对JAS分布的上下极端捐赠者进行外周血单核细胞转录组分析（n = 10）时，研究发现免疫相关基因的表达在不同组别之间存在显著差异。这一发现表明，祖先基因组变异可能在免疫系统的表型表现上产生影响。为了进一步验证血清甘油三酯的关联是否与肝细胞表型一致，研究团队将这些捐赠者的hiPSC分化为肝细胞样细胞。然而，组间的细胞内甘油三酯和脂质相关基因表达并未显示出显著差异。

这些结果强调了基于基因特征的hiPSC框架在不同细胞环境中研究祖先相关表型的潜在价值，尽管在肝细胞样细胞的实验中未能观察到预期的表型差异。这一研究为理解祖先基因组变异如何影响现代人群的表型多样性提供了新的视角，并为未来的相关研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Cromosomal genomes assemblies of twelve sheep breeds
items.abstract: The sheep research community benefits from a genome assembly that has been refined over the last 15 years. However, the rich diversity of sheep breeds suggests that a single individual genome is not enough to represent the species full genomic content. Third-generation sequencing technologies have recently made it possible to generate high quality assemblies that should enable to elucidate unique and/or complex phenotype determinisms depending on genetic structural variations. In the SeqOccin project, twelve breeds were selected to represent (mostly French) sheep genetic diversity: Basco-Bearnaise, Black Belly, Blanche du Massif Central, Corse, Ile de France, Lacaune, Manech Tete Noire, Noire du Velay, Ouessant, Rambouillet, Vendeen, Soay. High-molecular-weight DNA was extracted from blood samples and subjected to long read whole-genome sequencing. The reads were used to generate de novo assemblies and were aligned onto the public reference to call structural variants. PacBio HiFi and parental Illumina reads were used to assemble phased haplotypes of the Lacaune breed. For the other breeds, PacBio raw (CLR) or ONT reads were generated. Our work demonstrates the feasibility of assembling genomes with a reasonable amount of data and appropriate software packages, delivering one high-quality assembly and 11 standard sheep assemblies that pave the way for pangenome construction and structural variant functional studies.
items.authors: ECHE, C.; Birdes, C.; Marcuzzo, C.; Sarry, J.; Suin, A.; Vernette, C.; Kuchly, C.; Gaspin, C.; Milan, D.; Donnadieu, C.; Iampietro, C.; Tosser-Klopp, G.; Klopp, C.
items.title_zh: 十二种羊品种的染色体基因组组装
items.summary_zh: 本研究选取了十二种主要来自法国的羊品种（Basco-Bearnaise、Black Belly、Blanche du Massif Central、Corse、Ile de France、Lacaune、Manech Tete Noire、Noire du Velay、Ouessant、Rambouillet、Vendeen、Soay），以代表羊的遗传多样性。采用第三代测序技术，从血样中提取高分子量DNA，并进行长读长全基因组测序。通过de novo组装生成高质量基因组，并对公共参考基因组进行比对以调用结构变异。使用PacBio HiFi和父本Illumina读段组装Lacaune品种的相位单倍型，其他品种则生成了PacBio原始（CLR）或ONT读段。研究表明，利用合理的数据量和适当的软件包，可以有效组装基因组，提供一个高质量组装和11个标准羊基因组，为全基因组构建奠定基础。
items.l1_lead: 本研究成功组装了十二种羊品种的高质量基因组，为羊的遗传多样性研究和全基因组构建提供了重要基础。
items.l2_summary:
本研究选取了十二种主要来自法国的羊品种，包括Basco-Bearnaise、Black Belly、Blanche du Massif Central、Corse、Ile de France、Lacaune、Manech Tete Noire、Noire du Velay、Ouessant、Rambouillet、Vendeen和Soay，以代表羊的遗传多样性。研究采用第三代测序技术，从血样中提取高分子量DNA，并进行长读长全基因组测序。通过de novo组装，研究团队成功生成了高质量的基因组，并对公共参考基因组进行了比对，以调用结构变异。

在具体实施过程中，研究使用了PacBio HiFi和父本Illumina读段来组装Lacaune品种的相位单倍型，而其他品种则生成了PacBio原始（CLR）或ONT读段。研究结果表明，利用合理的数据量和适当的软件包，可以有效地组装基因组，从而提供一个高质量的基因组组装和11个标准羊基因组。这些成果为全基因组构建奠定了坚实的基础，展示了在羊遗传研究中应用先进测序技术的潜力。

总体而言，本研究不仅为羊的遗传多样性提供了重要的基因组数据，还为未来的遗传改良和育种研究提供了重要的参考依据。通过对不同羊品种的基因组进行深入分析，研究为理解羊的遗传特征和进化过程提供了新的视角，具有重要的科学价值和应用前景。

items.title: The Genetic Landscape of Structural Variants in Aspergillus flavus using ONT and PacBio Sequencing
items.abstract: Genetic rearrangement in the absence of selection is poorly understood. Long-read, high-depth sequencing has enabled analysis of the genetic landscape of spontaneous structural variants. We have applied PacBio Revio sequencing to identify the major classes of genetic alterations during long-term vegetative growth in Aspergillus flavus. These classes include a) precise deletions frequently associated with the flanking region of homology, b) clusters of short deletions that are heavily enriched within centromeric and subtelomeric regions that are typically 94% A+T, and c) deletions and expansions within a subset of homopolymer tracts. We find 70 homopolymer tracts longer than 44 bp, dispersed throughout the genome in noncoding regions and unassociated with transposable elements. A broader analysis of third-generation sequenced datasets from fungi found within the Phylum Ascomycota showed a high but variable prevalence of homopolymeric tracts across species. The adventitious identification of a putative flbA mutation, responsible for an altered conidial phenotype, by the Deep Variant AI system also demonstrates the power of this approach. These studies show that high-depth, long-read sequencing can probe SNPs, indels, homopolymeric tracts, and large-scale rearrangements in an unbiased fashion, and demonstrate that short deletions and homopolymer tract expansions arise spontaneously in A. flavus and other filamentous fungi.
items.authors: Woods, A.; Lohmar, J. M.; Malik, A.; Lustig, A. J.
items.title_zh: 使用ONT和PacBio测序解析黄曲霉的结构变异遗传图谱
items.summary_zh: 在缺乏选择的情况下，遗传重排的机制尚不清楚。我们应用PacBio Revio测序技术，分析了黄曲霉在长期营养生长过程中主要的遗传变异类型。这些类型包括：a) 与同源区域相邻的精确缺失，b) 集中在典型含94% A+T的着丝粒和亚端粒区域的短缺失簇，c) 一部分同聚合物序列中的缺失和扩展。我们发现基因组中有70个长度超过44 bp的同聚合物序列，分布在非编码区域且与转座元件无关。对子囊菌门中真菌的第三代测序数据的广泛分析显示，不同物种中同聚合物序列的出现频率高但变化大。通过Deep Variant AI系统意外识别出可能导致分生孢子表型改变的flbA突变，进一步展示了该方法的强大。这些研究表明，高深度长读长测序能够以无偏方式探测SNP、插入缺失、同聚合物序列及大规模重排，且短缺失和同聚合物序列扩展是自发产生的。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，使用高深度长读长测序技术可以无偏探测黄曲霉的遗传变异，包括短缺失和同聚合物序列扩展，揭示其自发产生机制。
items.l2_summary:
本研究利用PacBio Revio测序技术，深入解析了黄曲霉（Aspergillus flavus）在长期营养生长过程中所产生的主要遗传变异类型，旨在揭示缺乏选择情况下遗传重排的机制。研究发现，黄曲霉的遗传变异主要包括三种类型：首先是与同源区域相邻的精确缺失；其次是集中在典型含94% A+T的着丝粒和亚端粒区域的短缺失簇；最后是同聚合物序列中的缺失和扩展。通过分析基因组，研究团队识别出70个长度超过44 bp的同聚合物序列，这些序列分布在非编码区域且与转座元件无关，显示出其在基因组中的重要性。

此外，研究还通过对子囊菌门（Ascomycota）中真菌的第三代测序数据进行广泛分析，发现不同物种中同聚合物序列的出现频率较高，但其变化幅度较大。这一发现为理解这些序列在不同物种中的功能和演化提供了新的视角。值得注意的是，研究中还通过Deep Variant AI系统意外识别出可能导致分生孢子表型改变的flbA突变，进一步展示了该方法在遗传变异检测中的强大能力。

总体而言，这项研究表明，高深度长读长测序技术能够以无偏的方式有效探测单核苷酸多态性（SNP）、插入缺失、同聚合物序列及大规模重排，且短缺失和同聚合物序列的扩展是自发产生的。这些发现不仅为黄曲霉的遗传变异提供了新的见解，也为相关领域的研究提供了重要的技术支持和理论基础。

items.title: GenDiMug: a generic inclusive multigraph framework to analyze genomic organizations and -omics data at multiple scales
items.abstract: After decades of investigation, analyses of genome organization remain challenging. This is because genome descriptions are very information-rich and usually rendered as a linear map of genomic features corresponding to an ordered list of position intervals on a nucleic acid macromolecular backbone. This formalism, while accurate, is not fully optimized to mathematically analyze all genome structural properties, in particular the relations between genomic features, nor to integrate large amounts of -omics data, such as transcriptomes, epigenomes, proteomes, meltomes or chromatin accessibility data, which are increasingly available. We therefore developed GenDiMug, a tool that uses a network representation of the genome as a backbone, providing a natural framework to integrate spatial and ontogenetic relationships between genomic features and multi-omics data. We illustrate how this generic approach can be applied to all sorts of genomes, both to visualize genomic topology at contig and chromosomal scales at base-pair resolution, and to analyze genome positional effects using various graph metrics. Using GenDiMug, we further reveal clumping of genes with similar expression levels in eukaryotic genomes and their possible circadian regulation in a photosynthetic alga.
items.authors: Teuliere, J.; Lopez, P.; Corel, E.; Llorente, B.; Bapteste, E.
items.title_zh: GenDiMug：通用多重图框架分析基因组组织及-组学数据
items.summary_zh: 基因组组织的分析经过数十年的研究仍然面临挑战，主要因为基因组描述信息丰富，通常以线性图形式呈现，无法全面优化基因组结构特性及特征间关系的数学分析。为此，我们开发了GenDiMug工具，利用基因组的网络表示作为基础，提供了一个自然框架来整合基因组特征及多组学数据的空间和发生关系。该方法可应用于各种基因组，能够以碱基对分辨率可视化基因组拓扑，并使用图形度量分析基因组位置效应。通过GenDiMug，我们进一步揭示了真核生物基因组中表达水平相似基因的聚集现象及其可能的昼夜节律调控。
items.l1_lead: GenDiMug工具通过网络表示整合基因组特征与多组学数据，揭示了真核生物基因组中基因表达聚集及其昼夜节律调控的现象。
items.l2_summary:
基因组组织的分析在过去几十年中一直面临诸多挑战，主要原因在于基因组的描述信息极为丰富，通常以线性图的形式呈现，这种方式无法全面优化基因组结构特性及特征间关系的数学分析。为了解决这一问题，我们开发了GenDiMug工具，该工具基于基因组的网络表示，提供了一个自然的框架来整合基因组特征及多组学数据的空间和发生关系。GenDiMug方法适用于各种基因组，能够以碱基对分辨率可视化基因组拓扑，并通过图形度量分析基因组位置效应。

通过使用GenDiMug，我们进一步揭示了真核生物基因组中表达水平相似基因的聚集现象。这一发现表明，在基因组的特定区域内，具有相似表达水平的基因往往会聚集在一起，这可能与昼夜节律的调控机制有关。这种聚集现象不仅为理解基因组的功能组织提供了新的视角，也为研究基因表达调控的时序性提供了重要线索。总之，GenDiMug工具的开发为基因组组织及多组学数据的分析提供了一个创新的解决方案，推动了基因组学研究的深入发展。

items.title: Inferring ecDNA Evolution from Allele Frequency Spectra
items.abstract: Extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA) can arise early in the development of aggressive tumors or later upon progression, but the impact of chronology on patient outcome is not known. Currently, it is not possible to determine when an ecDNA arose in the course of tumor development and progression, based on genome sequencing data. Here, we develop an analytic method, ecEvol, to infer ecDNA emergence time, selection strength, mutation rate, and clonal dominance from allele frequency spectra in bulk whole-genome sequencing. EcEvol outperforms other methods and predicts parameters with high accuracy across a wide range of parameter values. Applying ecEvol to primary, treatment-naive tumors, we find that ecDNA typically emerges early and undergoes strong positive selection, albeit with substantial variation across cancer types. EcDNAs carrying known oncogenes emerge earlier and reach greater clonal dominance than ecDNAs lacking known oncogenes. In advanced and predominantly treated tumors, ecDNA emerges substantially later than in matched primary tumors, consistent with the generation and selection of new ecDNA during tumor progression and therapy. Longitudinal samples further support continued expansion of ecDNA-bearing lineages. Finally, earlier ecDNA emergence is associated with poorer overall survival. These results provide insight into the chronology of ecDNA formation from a single tumor biopsy taken at any point during the course of the disease, revealing that allele-frequency spectra encode the evolutionary history of ecDNA and provide a quantitative framework for reconstructing its emergence and expansion.
items.authors: Dameracharla, B.; Prasad, G.; Luebeck, J.; Amin, S.; Kirkland, J.; Chapman, O. S.; Chavez, L.; Verhaak, R.; Huang, W.; Mischel, P. S.; Werner, B.; Bafna, V.
items.title_zh: 从等位基因频率谱推断ecDNA进化
items.summary_zh: 外染色体DNA（ecDNA）可以在侵袭性肿瘤的早期发展中产生，也可能在后期进展中出现，但其时间对患者预后的影响尚不清楚。本文开发了一种分析方法ecEvol，从全基因组测序中的等位基因频率谱推断ecDNA的出现时间、选择强度、突变率和克隆优势。ecEvol在广泛的参数值范围内优于其他方法，预测参数的准确性高。对初级、未接受治疗的肿瘤应用ecEvol发现，ecDNA通常早期出现并经历强烈的正选择，但不同癌症类型之间存在显著差异。携带已知癌基因的ecDNA出现较早，且克隆优势更强。相比之下，在晚期和主要接受治疗的肿瘤中，ecDNA的出现时间显著晚于匹配的初级肿瘤，表明在肿瘤进展和治疗过程中生成和选择新的ecDNA。纵向样本进一步支持携带ecDNA的谱系持续扩展。最后，早期ecDNA出现与较差的总体生存率相关。这些结果为ecDNA形成的时间顺序提供了见解。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，外染色体DNA（ecDNA）通常在侵袭性肿瘤早期出现，并与较差的生存率相关，不同癌症类型间存在显著差异。
items.l2_summary:
外染色体DNA（ecDNA）在侵袭性肿瘤的发展中扮演着重要角色，但其出现时间对患者预后的影响尚不明确。为了解决这一问题，研究者们开发了一种名为ecEvol的分析方法，该方法通过全基因组测序中的等位基因频率谱来推断ecDNA的出现时间、选择强度、突变率和克隆优势。ecEvol在广泛的参数值范围内表现优于其他方法，能够高效且准确地预测这些参数。

在对初级、未接受治疗的肿瘤进行ecEvol分析时，研究发现ecDNA通常在早期阶段就出现，并经历了强烈的正选择，然而不同类型的癌症之间在ecDNA的出现时间和选择强度上存在显著差异。特别是，携带已知癌基因的ecDNA出现得更早，且其克隆优势更为明显。相较之下，在晚期和主要接受治疗的肿瘤中，ecDNA的出现时间显著晚于匹配的初级肿瘤，这表明在肿瘤的进展和治疗过程中，新的ecDNA会被生成并受到选择。

纵向样本的分析进一步支持了携带ecDNA的谱系持续扩展的观点，显示出ecDNA在肿瘤演变中的动态变化。研究还发现，早期ecDNA的出现与较差的总体生存率相关，这为ecDNA形成的时间顺序提供了重要见解。这些结果不仅揭示了ecDNA在肿瘤发展中的关键作用，也为未来的肿瘤治疗策略提供了潜在的生物标志物和靶点。

items.title: In silico subtractive genomics and reverse vaccinology approach reveal outer membrane proteins OMP47 and LptD as dual-purpose drug and vaccine targets in Pasteurella multocida Pm70
items.abstract: Drug targets and vaccines for bacterial diseases are challenging to develop. Computational subtractive genomics and reverse vaccinology offer a viable substitute for conventional drug and vaccine development approaches. In recent years, Pasteurella multocida, a Gram-negative pathogen responsible for severe infections in humans along with major diseases in livestock and poultry, has developed resistance to multiple drugs. As a result, there is an urgent demand for research into reliable, efficient, highly potent, and cost-effective strategies to combat the rise of Pasteurella multocida infections. To address this, the present study integrated an in silico subtractive genomics and reverse vaccinology workflow to pinpoint proteins with potential value as both drug and vaccine targets. From the complete Pasteurella multocida Pm70 proteome, we identified 446 proteins that had no similarities with human proteins, out of which 129 were found to be essential for the pathogens survival. These 129 proteins are therefore potential candidates for drug development. Further metabolic pathway analysis, virulence potential, subcellular localization, and structural analyses revealed two outer membrane proteins, namely, 47 kDa outer membrane protein and lipopolysaccharide-assembly protein LptD, as promising candidates for therapeutic development. Subsequent antigenicity analysis revealed both outer membrane proteins as potential vaccine targets, exhibiting highly favorable antigenicity scores. Candidate B- and T-cell epitopes were systematically mapped from these two targets based on antigenicity, immunogenicity, toxicity, and allergenicity potential and only high-confidence epitopes were assembled using adjuvants and class-specific linkers to construct the final multi-epitope vaccine (MEV). The designed MEV construct was demonstrated to be highly antigenic, non-toxic and non-allergenic to humans, while possessing favorable structural and physicochemical properties, and exhibited strong binding interactions with human toll-like receptors with minimal molecular deformability. Although further experimental validation is recommended to fully assess their efficacy, the present study establishes a solid foundation for the development of novel therapeutics and vaccine candidates against P. multocida, ultimately contributing to the reduction of its rising infections.
items.authors: Khan Chowdhury, A. R.; Islam, S.; Farid, A.; Lamia, F.; Ahmad, T. F.; Hossain, N. J.; Paul, A. R.; Afrin, T.; Elias, S. M.
items.title_zh: 计算减法基因组学与逆疫苗学揭示多杀性巴氏杆菌OMP47和LptD为双重靶点
items.summary_zh: 针对细菌疾病的药物靶点和疫苗开发面临挑战。本文采用计算减法基因组学和逆疫苗学的方法，研究多杀性巴氏杆菌（Pasteurella multocida），该菌为人类和家畜、家禽引起严重感染的革兰氏阴性病原体，并已对多种药物产生耐药性。研究从完整的多杀性巴氏杆菌Pm70蛋白组中识别出446种与人类蛋白无相似性的蛋白，其中129种被认为对病原体生存至关重要，成为潜在药物开发候选靶点。进一步的代谢途径分析、毒力潜力、亚细胞定位和结构分析显示，47 kDa外膜蛋白和脂多糖组装蛋白LptD为有前景的治疗开发候选靶点。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，多杀性巴氏杆菌的OMP47和LptD蛋白是潜在的双重药物靶点，为抗菌药物和疫苗开发提供了新方向。
items.l2_summary:
针对细菌疾病的药物靶点和疫苗开发面临诸多挑战，本文采用计算减法基因组学和逆疫苗学的方法，深入研究了多杀性巴氏杆菌（Pasteurella multocida），这是一种革兰氏阴性病原体，能够引起人类及家畜、家禽的严重感染，并且对多种药物产生了耐药性。研究团队从完整的多杀性巴氏杆菌Pm70蛋白组中识别出446种与人类蛋白无相似性的蛋白，这些蛋白被认为是潜在的药物开发靶点。其中，129种蛋白被认为对病原体的生存至关重要，进一步增强了其作为靶点的潜力。

在对这些蛋白进行深入分析后，研究者们进行了代谢途径分析、毒力潜力评估、亚细胞定位和结构分析，最终确定了47 kDa外膜蛋白和脂多糖组装蛋白LptD为有前景的治疗开发候选靶点。这一发现不仅为多杀性巴氏杆菌的治疗提供了新的思路，也为未来的疫苗研发奠定了基础。通过识别这些关键靶点，研究为应对该病原体的感染提供了重要的科学依据，并为开发新型抗菌药物和疫苗提供了潜在的方向。

items.title: Version-aware question answering over living oncology guidelines
items.abstract: Living clinical guidelines revise recommendations as evidence emerges, so an AI answer can be faithful to a real guideline and still be out of date. Here we examine this failure using ASCOBench, 288 unique questions in 96 three-turn conversations grounded in versioned American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) breast and prostate cancer guidelines, with oncologist-reviewed reference answers. Oncologists corrected one in four version-sensitive answers drafted by a frontier model, against fewer than one in ten factual ones. Across the guideline corpus, 19 recommendations changed between versions, seven of them reversals, yet only 1 of 14 superseded documents states that it has been replaced. With a strong model, retrieval over several guideline versions made stale answers four times more frequent than answering without retrieval. SentryLine, a verification-first system, lowered incorrect answers to 4.2-5.2% from 9.7-22.9% for baselines across three models. Recognizing change before a guideline declares it remains an open problem.
items.authors: Ravi Kumar, T.; Kaniyar Narayana Iyengar, A. I.; Khan, M. A.; Khakwani, K. Z. R.; Kathuria, K.; Sonbol, M. B.; Riaz, I.; Gupta, V.
items.title_zh: 基于版本的肿瘤学指南问答研究
items.summary_zh: 活跃的临床指南会随着证据的出现而修订建议，因此AI回答可能忠实于真实指南，但仍可能过时。本文使用ASCOBench考察这一问题，分析了基于版本的美国临床肿瘤学会（ASCO）乳腺癌和前列腺癌指南的96个三轮对话中的288个独特问题，并提供了肿瘤专家审核的参考答案。肿瘤专家纠正了四分之一的版本敏感答案，而事实性答案的纠正率不到十分之一。在指南文献中，有19条建议在版本间发生变化，其中7条是反转，但只有14个被替代文档中的1个声明其已被替换。使用强模型时，跨多个指南版本的检索使得过时答案的出现频率比不检索时高出四倍。SentryLine系统通过优先验证，将错误答案率从基线的9.7-22.9%降低至4.2-5.2%。在指南声明变化之前识别变化仍然是一个未解决的问题。
items.l1_lead: 活跃的临床指南在更新时可能导致AI回答过时，研究发现版本敏感答案的纠正率较高，且使用强模型检索时过时答案频率显著增加。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了基于版本的肿瘤学指南在临床应用中的有效性，特别是针对美国临床肿瘤学会（ASCO）乳腺癌和前列腺癌指南的研究。随着新的证据的出现，活跃的临床指南会不断修订，因此，人工智能（AI）提供的答案可能会忠实于现有指南，但仍可能存在过时的风险。研究使用ASCOBench工具分析了96个三轮对话中的288个独特问题，并提供了肿瘤专家审核的参考答案。结果显示，肿瘤专家纠正了四分之一的版本敏感答案，而事实性答案的纠正率则不到十分之一。这表明，版本更新对临床决策的影响显著。

在分析的指南文献中，有19条建议在不同版本间发生了变化，其中7条建议被反转。然而，只有14个替代文档中的1个明确声明其已被替换，显示出信息传递的不充分性。研究还发现，当使用强模型进行跨多个指南版本的检索时，过时答案的出现频率比不进行检索时高出四倍，这进一步强调了及时更新信息的重要性。为了解决这一问题，SentryLine系统通过优先验证的方式，将错误答案率从基线的9.7%-22.9%降低至4.2%-5.2%。尽管如此，如何在指南声明变化之前及时识别这些变化仍然是一个未解决的问题。

综上所述，本文揭示了在临床肿瘤学中，基于版本的指南更新对AI回答的影响，以及在实际应用中存在的信息更新滞后问题，强调了持续监测和验证指南内容的重要性，以确保临床决策的准确性和时效性。

items.title: AI-Driven Design of Next-Generation Immunoinformatics Multi-Epitope Subunit Vaccine Targeting the Most Virulent Mpox Proteome: A Structural and Kinetic Validation Framework
items.abstract: The resurgence of the Mpox virus (MPXV) highlights the urgent need for scalable, mutation-resistant countermeasures. Slow development timelines hinder traditional empirical vaccine discovery, while conventional vaccinology often yields high false-positive rates because it relies on static, linear sequence-based screening. These classical informatics filters consistently fail to predict physical structural stability or the dynamic presentation of immune cells under physiological conditions, creating a distinct translational gap between computational design and in vitro efficacy. To address these limitations, here we engineered an advanced, AI-augmented vaccine discovery pipeline targeting the most virulent components of the MPXV proteome. We systematically screened eight critical viral targets essential for replication, membrane morphogenesis, and host-cell entry to map highly conserved T-cell and B-cell epitopes. Moving beyond standard heuristic filtering, we implemented a high-fidelity deep learning validation layer: ESM-2 protein language models (pLMs) were deployed to calculate pseudo-perplexity scores across chimeric linker junctions (EAAAK, GPGPG) to guarantee structural naturalness, MHCflurry ensemble models successfully verified active intracellular antigen presentation, and structure-informed graph neural networks (GNNs) simulated the physical node-attention dynamics of the immune synapse. Finally, recurrent neural networks (RNNs)-driven mRNA kinetic modeling optimized translation initiation rates and minimum free energy profiles during in silico cloning. This multi-layered pipeline successfully yielded three structurally refined, multi-epitope vaccine constructs optimized for maximum global population coverage. ESM-2 structural validation confirmed exceptionally low perplexity scores at structural junctions, indicating that the engineered chimaeras have native-like stability and a minimized risk of proteolysis. GNN-based immune synapse modeling demonstrated highly stable binding kinetics and robust binding free energies between the target epitopes and human HLA alleles. Furthermore, RNN kinetic optimizations established that the cDNA sequences are optimized for high-yield expression in heterologous expression hosts without risk of ribosomal stalling or translational bottlenecks. This study establishes a deep learning-augmented framework that bridges the gap between theoretical sequence optimization and biopharmaceutical scalability. By validating the structural naturalness, real-world immunogenicity, and manufacturing kinetics of our vaccine chimeras, this framework presents a robust, proactive paradigm for rapid vaccine architecture against emerging orthopoxvirus threats.
items.authors: Emon, M.; Siddiqque, N. H.; Haque, M. E.
items.title_zh: 基于AI设计的下一代Mpox多表位亚单位疫苗研究
items.summary_zh: Mpox病毒（MPXV）的复苏凸显了对可扩展、抗突变对策的迫切需求。传统疫苗发现的缓慢进程和高假阳性率限制了有效疫苗的开发。为解决这些问题，我们构建了一个先进的AI增强疫苗发现流程，针对MPXV蛋白组中最具毒性的成分。我们系统筛选了八个关键病毒靶点，映射高度保守的T细胞和B细胞表位。通过实施高保真深度学习验证层，使用ESM-2蛋白语言模型计算伪困惑度分数，确保结构自然性，并通过MHCflurry模型验证活跃的细胞内抗原呈递，最终利用结构信息图神经网络模拟物理节点注意力动态。这一研究为疫苗设计提供了新的思路。
items.l1_lead: 基于AI的疫苗发现流程成功筛选出针对Mpox病毒的关键靶点，为开发高效、抗突变的疫苗提供了创新思路。
items.l2_summary: Mpox病毒（MPXV）的复苏引发了对可扩展且抗突变疫苗的迫切需求，传统疫苗发现的缓慢进程和高假阳性率限制了有效疫苗的开发。为了解决这些问题，研究团队构建了一个先进的基于人工智能（AI）的疫苗发现流程，专注于MPXV蛋白组中最具毒性的成分。通过系统筛选，研究人员确定了八个关键病毒靶点，并映射了高度保守的T细胞和B细胞表位。这一过程的核心在于实施高保真深度学习验证层，利用ESM-2蛋白语言模型计算伪困惑度分数，以确保所设计疫苗的结构自然性。此外，研究还通过MHCflurry模型验证了活跃的细胞内抗原呈递，确保疫苗能够有效激发免疫反应。最终，研究团队利用结构信息图神经网络模拟物理节点注意力动态，为疫苗设计提供了新的思路和方法。这一研究不仅展示了AI在疫苗开发中的潜力，也为应对未来可能出现的病毒变异提供了新的策略。

items.title: Mutation in Ralstonia pseudosolanacearum F1C1 cytochrome p450 homologue impairs virulence through root but not through shoot of tomato plants
items.abstract: Ralstonia pseudosolanacearum causes a lethal bacterial wilt disease in many plants. The pathogen enters through roots and systemically colonizes the xylem tissue, resulting in wilting and eventual death of the host. Using transposon mutagenesis followed by screening in tomato seedlings, we identified a mutant exhibiting virulence deficiency by root inoculation, but not by leaf inoculation. The mutation was recreated in the wild-type genome via natural transformation to prove the linkage of virulence deficiency with the transposon insertion. Whole genome sequencing revealed that the transposon insertion was in a cyp450 homologue, encoding cytochrome P450 monooxygenase. Two independent targeted mutations were generated in the cyp450 gene, and both the mutants recapitulated the root-specific virulence deficiency. The mutants rarely cause disease in mature plants following soil drenching but remained fully virulent upon petiole pricking inoculation. Complementation with the full length cyp450 gene amplified from the wild-type strain F1C1 restored virulence in the mutant. Compared to the wild-type F1C1, the cyp450 mutants exhibited greater sensitivity to tomato root extracts. HR-LCMS of tomato root extracts revealed the occurrence of several antimicrobial compounds. Cytochrome P450 enzymes are known to mediate the degradation or biosynthesis of diverse metabolites in bacteria. Considering the virulence difference due to the mode of inoculation, our findings indicate that cyp450 contributes to tissue-specific adaptation of the pathogen during infection has opened an avenue for integrating tissue metabolomics with bacterial wilt susceptibility research.

items.title_zh: Ralstonia pseudosolanacearum F1C1细胞色素P450同源体突变影响番茄根部致病性
items.summary_zh: Ralstonia pseudosolanacearum引起多种植物的致命细菌枯萎病。该病原通过根部进入并系统性地定殖木质部，导致宿主枯萎和最终死亡。通过转座子诱变和番茄幼苗筛选，我们鉴定出一种在根部接种时表现出致病性缺陷的突变体，而在叶部接种时则未见缺陷。通过自然转化在野生型基因组中重建该突变，以证明致病性缺陷与转座子插入的关联。全基因组测序显示转座子插入位于cyp450同源体中，编码细胞色素P450单氧化酶。生成了两个独立的cyp450基因靶向突变体，均重现了根部特异的致病性缺陷。突变体在土壤浇灌后很少导致成熟植物发病，但在叶柄刺入接种时仍保持完全致病性。用从野生型菌株F1C1扩增的全长cyp450基因进行补救，恢复了突变体的致病性。与野生型F1C1相比，cyp450突变体对番茄根提取物表现出更高的敏感性。番茄根提取物的HR-LCMS分析揭示了几种抗菌化合物的存在。细胞色素P450酶已知在细菌中介导多种代谢物的降解或生物合成。
items.l1_lead: Ralstonia pseudosolanacearum F1C1细胞色素P450同源体的突变导致其在番茄根部的致病性缺陷，但在叶部接种时未受影响，表明该基因在根部致病性中起关键作用。
items.l2_summary:
Ralstonia pseudosolanacearum是一种引起多种植物致命细菌枯萎病的病原体，能够通过根部侵入并在木质部系统性定殖，导致宿主植物枯萎并最终死亡。研究中通过转座子诱变和对番茄幼苗的筛选，鉴定出一种在根部接种时表现出致病性缺陷的突变体，而在叶部接种时则未见缺陷。为了验证这种致病性缺陷与转座子插入的关系，研究者通过自然转化在野生型基因组中重建了该突变。

全基因组测序结果显示，转座子插入位于cyp450同源体中，该基因编码细胞色素P450单氧化酶。研究团队进一步生成了两个独立的cyp450基因靶向突变体，均重现了根部特异的致病性缺陷。这些突变体在土壤浇灌后很少导致成熟植物发病，但在叶柄刺入接种时仍保持完全致病性。通过从野生型菌株F1C1扩增的全长cyp450基因进行补救，成功恢复了突变体的致病性。

此外，与野生型F1C1相比，cyp450突变体对番茄根提取物表现出更高的敏感性。对番茄根提取物进行的HR-LCMS分析揭示了几种抗菌化合物的存在，这表明细胞色素P450酶在细菌中可能介导多种代谢物的降解或生物合成。综上所述，cyp450同源体的突变显著影响了Ralstonia pseudosolanacearum在番茄根部的致病性，揭示了细胞色素P450在病原体与宿主植物相互作用中的重要角色。

items.title: The constitutive androstane receptor protects against metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease through sex specific interactions with the gut microbiota
items.abstract: Background: The gut-liver axis is involved in Metabolic dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD), but the host molecular actors involved in such dialogue have not yet been fully characterized. Objective: We investigated the sex-dependent role of the Constitutive Androstane Receptor (CAR) as a hepatic sensor of microbial signals in MASLD pathophysiology. Design: Male and female Car+/+ and Car-/- mice were fed a western diet (WD) for 4, 14 or 35 weeks. We performed plasma biochemistry, liver histology, bile acid and cholesterol quantification, untargeted multi-omics approach combining liver RNA-sequencing and 16S rRNA sequencing, together with co-housing, fecal microbiota transplantation and analysis of publicly available transcriptomics data in human cohorts. Results: Short-term WD revealed CAR-dependent protection against steatosis, together with perturbations in the transcriptional signatures of multiple transcription factors involved in hepatocyte identity in males. After 14 weeks, CAR deletion increased WD-induced liver damage, inflammation and fibrosis, and disrupted bile acid, cholesterol and gut microbiota homeostasis, in males only. Co-housing and fecal microbiota transplantations revealed that a Car+/+ gut microbiota protected against WD-induced liver damage, while a Car-/- microbiota was reshaped by a Car+/+ host. No CAR-dependent phenotype was observed in females. Finally, in human cohorts, hepatic CAR expression decreased in advanced clinical stages of MASLD. Conclusion: CAR is a sex-dependent protective nuclear receptor against MASLD progression, acting both as a transcriptional regulator of hepatocyte identity and as a mediator of the host-microbiota crosstalk.

items.title_zh: 构成性雄烯受体通过性别特异性与肠道微生物相互作用保护肝脏
items.summary_zh: 背景：肠-肝轴与代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病（MASLD）有关，但参与此对话的宿主分子尚未完全表征。目的：研究构成性雄烯受体（CAR）作为MASLD病理生理中微生物信号的肝脏传感器的性别依赖性作用。方法：对雄性和雌性Car+/+及Car-/-小鼠进行西方饮食（WD）喂养，持续4、14或35周。我们进行了血浆生化、肝脏组织学、胆汁酸和胆固醇定量、肝脏RNA测序和16S rRNA测序的多组学分析，以及共同饲养、粪便微生物移植和人类队列的公开转录组数据分析。结果：短期WD显示CAR依赖性保护雄性小鼠免受脂肪变性影响，14周后，CAR缺失增加了WD诱导的肝损伤、炎症和纤维化，并破坏了胆汁酸、胆固醇和肠道微生物的稳态，仅在雄性中观察到。共同饲养和粪便微生物移植显示Car+/+肠道微生物能够保护雄性小鼠免受WD诱导的肝损伤，而Car-/-微生物则被Car+/+宿主重塑。
items.l1_lead: 构成性雄烯受体通过性别特异性与肠道微生物相互作用，显著保护雄性小鼠免受西方饮食诱导的肝脏损伤。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了构成性雄烯受体（CAR）在性别特异性中对肠道微生物与肝脏保护作用的影响，尤其是在与代谢功能障碍相关的脂肪肝病（MASLD）中的作用。研究背景指出，肠-肝轴与MASLD密切相关，但参与这一过程的宿主分子尚未完全明确。为了深入理解CAR的作用，研究团队对雄性和雌性Car+/+及Car-/-小鼠进行了西方饮食（WD）喂养，持续时间为4、14或35周，并进行了多组学分析，包括血浆生化、肝脏组织学、胆汁酸和胆固醇定量、肝脏RNA测序及16S rRNA测序。

研究结果显示，短期WD喂养能够依赖CAR保护雄性小鼠免受脂肪变性影响。经过14周的WD喂养后，CAR缺失显著增加了雄性小鼠的肝损伤、炎症和纤维化程度，同时破坏了胆汁酸、胆固醇和肠道微生物的稳态，这一现象仅在雄性小鼠中观察到。通过共同饲养和粪便微生物移植实验，研究发现Car+/+小鼠的肠道微生物能够有效保护雄性小鼠免受WD诱导的肝损伤，而Car-/-小鼠的微生物则在Car+/+宿主的影响下发生了重塑。

综上所述，本研究揭示了CAR在雄性小鼠中通过调节肠道微生物群落，发挥对肝脏的保护作用，强调了性别在这一过程中的重要性。这一发现为理解肠-肝轴的机制提供了新的视角，并可能为MASLD的治疗提供新的靶点。

items.title: Gradients of local circuit architecture shape stability and information integration across the cortical hierarchy
items.abstract: The mammalian neocortex is a complex structure with many interacting regions and cell types. Multiple efforts have recently generated large datasets from multiple cortical regions to determine generalizing principles of cortical organization and activity. One such generalizing principle is the concept of a cortical hierarchy - low-dimensional macroscopic gradients of biological properties across cortical areas and a hierarchy of timescales for information processing. Such gradients in properties along a cortical hierarchy may explain how different cortical regions serve different computational roles (i.e. sensory processing versus working memory). We set out to investigate such principles using biologically realistic simulations. Starting from our previously published model of the mouse primary visual cortex (VISp) with updated connectivity reflecting recent large-scale connectomics and synaptic physiology datasets, we generated multiple versions of the cortical circuit model with increased connectivity as measured along the cortical hierarchy. We then measure the resulting neural activity in response to a simulated single-cell photostimulation paradigm and thalamocortical inputs. We found that overall circuit stability increased across the cortical hierarchy, due to both increases in connection density and increases in the relative proportion of SST cells. The results of this study link cortical cell types to population-level activity, generating insight into the function of local circuits across cortex.
items.authors: Green, L.; Ito, S.; Haufler, D.; Rozsa, M.; Wang, C.; Daie, K.; Arkhipov, A.
items.title_zh: 局部电路架构梯度影响皮层层级的信息整合与稳定性
items.summary_zh: 哺乳动物的新皮层是一个复杂的结构，包含多个相互作用的区域和细胞类型。近期的研究生成了来自多个皮层区域的大型数据集，以确定皮层组织和活动的普遍原则。皮层层级的概念是其中之一，表现为皮层区域生物特性的低维宏观梯度及信息处理的时间尺度层级。我们通过生物学上合理的模拟研究这些原则，从之前的鼠类初级视觉皮层模型出发，更新了连接性以反映最新的大规模连接组学和突触生理数据集。我们生成了多个连接性增强的皮层电路模型，并测量了在模拟单细胞光刺激和丘脑皮层输入下的神经活动。结果显示，皮层层级的整体电路稳定性提高，这归因于连接密度的增加和SST细胞相对比例的增加。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，通过增强皮层电路的连接性和增加SST细胞比例，可以提高皮层层级的信息整合与整体电路的稳定性。
items.l2_summary:
哺乳动物的新皮层是一个复杂的结构，包含多个相互作用的区域和细胞类型。近期的研究通过生成来自多个皮层区域的大型数据集，旨在确定皮层组织和活动的普遍原则，其中一个重要概念是皮层层级（cortical hierarchy），它表现为皮层区域生物特性的低维宏观梯度及信息处理的时间尺度层级。研究者们通过生物学上合理的模拟，基于鼠类初级视觉皮层模型，更新了连接性，以反映最新的大规模连接组学（connectomics）和突触生理（synaptic physiology）数据集。

在此基础上，研究团队生成了多个连接性增强的皮层电路模型，并在模拟单细胞光刺激和丘脑皮层输入下测量了神经活动。结果表明，皮层层级的整体电路稳定性显著提高，这一现象归因于连接密度的增加以及抑制性中间神经元（SST细胞，somatostatin-expressing interneurons）相对比例的增加。这些发现为理解皮层层级的信息整合与稳定性提供了新的视角，强调了连接性在神经网络功能中的关键作用。通过这些研究，科学家们能够更深入地探讨皮层的组织结构与功能之间的关系，为未来的神经科学研究奠定了基础。

items.title: Primate Gaze Behavior Reflects Change of Mind in a Naturalistic Navigation Task
items.abstract: Revising a decision while acting on it is a fundamental aspect of natural behavior, yet the underlying computations are difficult to track in real time. To explore how such belief updates unfold, we tested whether eye movements reveal a subject's change of mind during a naturalistic navigation task with a binary target choice. Humans and monkeys were required to navigate to one of two goal locations presented either simultaneously or sequentially in a virtual environment where explicit position cues were absent. Our findings reveal that gaze continuously tracks the latent variable, including changes of mind. We found that the target tracking accuracy before the second target is even presented during sequential target trials predicts whether the subject's navigational goal persists (first target choice) or changes (second target choice). These results underscore the importance of gaze in action planning and changes of mind, supporting the hypothesis that eye movements embody not only the current latent variable but also its uncertainty.
items.authors: Choi, W.; Alefantis, P.; Andreadakis, G.; Angelaki, D. E.
items.title_zh: 灵长类动物注视行为反映自然导航任务中的思维变化
items.summary_zh: 修正决策是自然行为的基本方面，但实时追踪其计算过程较为困难。为探讨信念更新的过程，我们测试了眼动是否揭示了受试者在无明确位置线索的虚拟环境中进行二元目标选择的自然导航任务中的思维变化。研究对象包括人类和猴子。结果显示，注视行为持续追踪潜在变量，包括思维变化。在顺序目标试验中，第二个目标呈现前的目标追踪准确性能够预测受试者的导航目标是保持（第一个目标选择）还是改变（第二个目标选择）。这些结果强调了注视在行动规划和思维变化中的重要性，支持眼动不仅体现当前潜在变量，还反映其不确定性的假设。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，灵长类动物的注视行为能够反映其在自然导航任务中的思维变化，揭示决策过程中的信念更新和不确定性。
items.l2_summary: 本研究探讨了灵长类动物在自然导航任务中的思维变化，特别是通过眼动行为来追踪决策过程。研究对象包括人类和猴子，旨在揭示在没有明确位置线索的虚拟环境中进行二元目标选择时，受试者的信念更新过程。结果表明，注视行为能够持续追踪潜在变量，反映出思维变化的动态过程。在顺序目标试验中，研究发现，在第二个目标呈现之前，受试者对第一个目标的追踪准确性能够有效预测其导航目标的选择是保持（即选择第一个目标）还是改变（即选择第二个目标）。这一发现强调了注视行为在行动规划和思维变化中的重要性，支持了眼动不仅反映当前潜在变量，还能够体现其不确定性的假设。这项研究为理解灵长类动物的决策过程提供了新的视角，揭示了注视行为在认知过程中的关键作用。

items.title: Impacts of different SETD1A mutations and genetic backgrounds on human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived hippocampal neurons
items.abstract: Abstract Human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) provide a translational platform to interrogate the impact of genetic risk factors for various disorders on human biology. It has been a common practice to engineer premature stop codons to model predicted loss-of-function mutations using isogenic hiPSCs, yet effects of mutation position for the same gene and genetic background have been rarely tested systematically and at multiple levels for comparison to those of patient-specific mutations. Ultra-rare, heterozygous, and predicted loss-of-function mutations in the SETD1A gene, which encodes a H3K4 methyltransferase, are highly penetrant genetic risk factors for schizophrenia. Here, we generated a large panel of isogenic heterozygous SETD1A mutant hiPSC lines, including premature stop-codon mutations in one early exon and one late exon in five genetic backgrounds and two patient-specific mutations, to gain insight into molecular, cellular, and functional changes in a disease-relevant and highly pure population of human hippocampal dentate granule cell-like neurons. Our multi-level analyses showed that different SETD1A mutations lead to divergent molecular and cellular phenotypes related to synapses, but convergent neuronal network deficits, while the genetic background influences gene expression with no substantial effects at cellular and network levels. Mechanistic analysis confirmed the early exon patient mutation as loss-of-function, but revealed that the predicted loss-of-function patient mutation in the late exon is likely gain-of-function. Consequently, while all mutations decreased global H3K4me3 levels, deficits were only partially rescued by inhibiting H3K4 demethylase LSD1 for early exon mutations, but not for late exon mutations. Together, these results suggest that highly penetrant mutations can lead to similar cellular and functional phenotypes across different genetic backgrounds, whereas different premature stop-codon mutations could have contrasting impacts due to distinct mechanisms. Our findings have practical implications for applying genome-editing in hiPSCs to model disorders, highlight the value of modeling patient-specific mutations and testing multiple mutations, and suggest the need for tailored mutation-dependent therapeutic strategies.
items.authors: Hong, Y.; Zhao, T.; Yang, Q.; Zhang, H.; Ma, X.; Su, X.; Liu, J.; Zhang, S.; Mendez-Maldonado, K.; Zhou, Y.; Zou, J.; Kreimer, A.; Sawa, A.; Christian, K.; Pang, Z.; Duan, J.; Song, H.; Ming, G.-L.
items.title_zh: 不同SETD1A突变及遗传背景对人诱导多能干细胞衍生海马神经元的影响
items.summary_zh: 人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）为研究各种疾病的遗传风险因素对人类生物学的影响提供了转化平台。本研究生成了一大批同源杂合SETD1A突变hiPSC系，包含在五种遗传背景下的早期外显子和晚期外显子的早停密码子突变，以及两个患者特异性突变，以探讨人类海马齿状回颗粒细胞样神经元的分子、细胞和功能变化。多层次分析显示，不同SETD1A突变导致与突触相关的分子和细胞表型差异，但神经网络缺陷趋同，而遗传背景影响基因表达，但对细胞和网络水平没有显著影响。
items.l1_lead: 不同SETD1A突变在海马神经元中引发突触相关分子和细胞表型差异，遗传背景影响基因表达但对细胞和网络水平影响不显著。
items.l2_summary:
本研究利用人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）作为转化平台，探讨不同SETD1A突变及其遗传背景对人类海马齿状回颗粒细胞样神经元的影响。研究团队生成了一系列同源杂合SETD1A突变hiPSC系，这些突变包括在五种不同遗传背景下的早期外显子和晚期外显子的早停密码子突变，以及两个患者特异性突变。通过对这些细胞系的多层次分析，研究发现不同的SETD1A突变导致了与突触相关的分子和细胞表型的显著差异，表明突变对神经元的分子机制产生了影响。然而，尽管突变引起的细胞表型存在差异，神经网络的缺陷表现出趋同的特征，说明不同突变可能在网络功能上产生相似的影响。

此外，遗传背景对基因表达的影响也得到了证实，但在细胞和网络水平上并未观察到显著的差异。这一发现提示，虽然遗传背景可能会影响基因的表达模式，但在细胞功能和神经网络的整体表现上，其影响相对有限。综上所述，本研究揭示了SETD1A突变在神经元发育中的复杂作用，强调了突变类型和遗传背景在神经生物学研究中的重要性，为理解相关疾病的遗传风险因素提供了新的视角。

items.title: A Hypothalamic Pathway for Energy Conservation
items.abstract: Many animals utilize a survival strategy of hypothermia, inactivity, and a dramatic decrease in their energy metabolism when faced with a shortfall in energy supplies. Mice, for example, show daily torpor that may last several hours to bridge the lack of energy availability in a cold environment. While our recent studies identified a population of neurons in the median preoptic nucleus (MnPO) necessary for fasting-induced torpor regulation, the specific brain circuits that trigger energy conservation in response to food restriction are unknown. We show here that the energy state of the animal is conveyed to preoptic neurons by inputs from the arcuate nucleus (ARC), a region known to be indispensable for driving metabolic and behavioral adaptations to the fasted state. We first found that the activity of ARC neurons expressing Agouti-Related Peptide (ARCAgRP) is required for the generation of fasting-induced torpor. Then, we showed that torpor-active ARCAgRP neurons innervate the preoptic area of the hypothalamus (POA), including the MnPO. Using optogenetic methods, we also found that activating the ARCAgRP-MnPO pathway induces key features of torpor: decreased body temperature, bradycardia, reduction of energy expenditure, and suppression of brown adipose tissue thermogenesis. Remarkably, we also show that inhibition of the ARCAgRP-MnPO brain circuit entirely prevents fasting-induced torpor. Furthermore, we identified that both NPY and GABA are neuromodulators used by ARCAgRP neurons to enable hypothermic responses during starvation. Our studies provide a detailed view of a hypothalamic pathway enabling energy conservation, a survival mechanism in conditions of low energy availability.
items.authors: Douglass, A.; Lynch, N.; Andina, M.; Ramirez-Plascencia, O.; Kucukdereli, H.; Melville, D.; Costa, L.; Yang, Y.; Qiu, C.; Bandaru, S.; Banks, A.; Hrvatin, S.; Saper, C.; Lowell, B. B.; Machado, N.
items.title_zh: 下丘脑能量保护通路研究
items.summary_zh: 许多动物在能量供应不足时会采用低温、 inactivity 和显著降低能量代谢的生存策略。小鼠在寒冷环境中会出现每日短暂的低温状态，以应对能量缺乏。我们的研究发现，位于中间前视核（MnPO）的一群神经元对禁食引起的低温调节至关重要，但具体的脑回路尚不清楚。我们发现，弓状核（ARC）向前视核神经元传递动物的能量状态，ARC在调节禁食状态的代谢和行为适应中不可或缺。研究表明，表达Agouti相关肽的ARC神经元的活性对于产生禁食引起的低温是必需的。此外，活跃的ARCAgRP神经元支配下丘脑前视区，包括MnPO。通过光遗传学方法，我们发现激活ARCAgRP-MnPO通路可诱导低温的关键特征：体温降低、心动过缓、能量消耗减少及棕色脂肪组织热生成抑制。值得注意的是，抑制ARCAgRP-MnPO脑回路可以完全阻止禁食引起的低温。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，弓状核神经元通过调节中间前视核对禁食引起的低温反应至关重要，激活该通路可诱导体温降低和能量消耗减少。
items.l2_summary:
下丘脑能量保护通路的研究揭示了动物在能量供应不足时所采取的生存策略，特别是低温、非活动状态和显著降低能量代谢。小鼠在寒冷环境中会经历每日短暂的低温状态，以应对能量缺乏。我们的研究重点关注位于中间前视核（MnPO）的一群神经元，这些神经元在禁食引起的低温调节中发挥了关键作用，但具体的脑回路尚不明确。我们发现，弓状核（ARC）向前视核神经元传递动物的能量状态，ARC在调节禁食状态下的代谢和行为适应中不可或缺。

研究表明，表达Agouti相关肽（AgRP）的ARC神经元的活性对于产生禁食引起的低温是必需的。活跃的ARCAgRP神经元支配下丘脑前视区，包括MnPO。通过光遗传学方法，我们发现激活ARCAgRP-MnPO通路能够诱导低温的关键特征，包括体温降低、心动过缓、能量消耗减少及棕色脂肪组织热生成抑制。值得注意的是，抑制ARCAgRP-MnPO脑回路可以完全阻止禁食引起的低温。这些发现为理解下丘脑在能量平衡和代谢调节中的作用提供了新的视角，揭示了神经元之间的相互作用如何影响动物在能量不足时的生理反应。

items.title: Plasticity-induced actin polymerization positions endocytic compartments at the bases of stimulated spines
items.abstract: The endocytic pathway plays key roles in facilitating and regulating synaptic plasticity, but how its components are organized at spines undergoing plasticity is not fully understood. Here we use live-cell imaging and single-particle tracking to examine the localization of endosomes and lysosomes in response to plasticity-inducing stimuli. We find that endosomes and lysosomes are positioned and retained near the bases of stimulated spines after the induction of structural plasticity in a manner dependent on actin polymerization in the dendritic shaft. Spines with endocytic compartments near their bases exhibit greater glutamate receptor turnover and more sustained enlargement after stimulation than spines lacking them. These results suggest that actin polymerization in the dendritic shaft acts as a hub to organize critical cellular machinery at the bases of spines undergoing synaptic plasticity.
items.authors: Wong, V. C.; Walpita, D.; Liu, Z. J.; O'Shea, E. K.
items.title_zh: 塑性诱导的肌动蛋白聚合定位内吞体于刺激性突触基部
items.summary_zh: 内吞途径在促进和调节突触可塑性中发挥关键作用，但其在经历可塑性的突触中的组分如何组织尚不完全清楚。本研究采用活细胞成像和单粒子追踪技术，探讨内吞体和溶酶体在塑性诱导刺激下的定位。结果发现，在结构可塑性诱导后，内吞体和溶酶体依赖于树突轴中的肌动蛋白聚合，定位并保持在刺激性突触的基部。与缺乏内吞体的突触相比，基部有内吞体的突触在刺激后表现出更高的谷氨酸受体周转率和更持久的增大。这些结果表明，树突轴中的肌动蛋白聚合作为一个中心，组织了在经历突触可塑性的突触基部的关键细胞机制。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示肌动蛋白聚合在塑性诱导下如何组织内吞体和溶酶体，促进突触基部的谷氨酸受体周转率和可塑性维持。
items.l2_summary: 内吞途径在突触可塑性中扮演着重要角色，但其在经历可塑性的突触中组分的组织方式尚不明确。本研究通过活细胞成像和单粒子追踪技术，深入探讨了内吞体（endosome）和溶酶体（lysosome）在塑性诱导刺激下的定位情况。研究结果显示，在结构可塑性诱导后，内吞体和溶酶体依赖于树突轴中的肌动蛋白（actin）聚合，成功定位并保持在刺激性突触的基部。与缺乏内吞体的突触相比，基部有内吞体的突触在刺激后表现出更高的谷氨酸受体（glutamate receptor）周转率和更持久的增大，表明内吞体的存在对突触功能的增强具有重要影响。这些发现表明，树突轴中的肌动蛋白聚合不仅是内吞体和溶酶体定位的基础，还作为一个中心机制，组织了在经历突触可塑性的突触基部的关键细胞过程。这一研究为理解突触可塑性提供了新的视角，强调了肌动蛋白在突触内吞体和溶酶体定位中的核心作用。

items.title: Inflections in adolescent cortical maturation signal psychopathology risk
items.abstract: Cerebral cortical maturation supports emotional, social, and cognitive development during adolescence1. Neurodevelopmental theories of psychiatric illnesses, which peak in onset around age 182, implicate subtle alterations in adolescent cortical development3. However, mechanistic links between cortical maturation and emergent psychopathology have remained elusive. This gap likely reflects a need for more nuanced understanding of cortical development4, larger, longitudinal samples powered to detect small effects,5 and more uniform image quality control.6 Using 29,482 structural MRI scans from 11,720 adolescents in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study, we demonstrate reproducible differences in the contour and tempo of maturation across the cortical surface. Regional trajectories are robust to image quality variance and align with increasing functional specialization over time. Thicker cortex in early-maturing sensory regions predicts psychiatric symptoms as early as four years prior to their emergence, a pattern that subsequently spreads to association cortex. Overlap with spatially and temporally organized gene co-expression networks implicates prenatal programming of this sequence of maturation and its links to psychopathology. These findings present a novel, versatile neurodevelopmental framework for cortical maturation during adolescence that sequentially implicates sensory and association cortex in risk for emergent psychiatric symptoms.

items.title_zh: 青少年皮层成熟中的变化信号精神病理风险
items.summary_zh: 大脑皮层的成熟支持青少年时期的情感、社交和认知发展。精神疾病的神经发育理论认为，青少年皮层发展中的细微变化与精神病的发生相关。我们利用来自青少年大脑认知发展（ABCD）研究的29,482个结构性MRI扫描，分析了11,720名青少年的皮层成熟轮廓和节奏，发现其差异具有可重复性。区域轨迹对图像质量的变化具有稳健性，并与功能专门化的增加相一致。早熟的感觉区域的皮层厚度可以预测精神症状，早至其出现前四年，这一模式随后扩展到联结皮层。与空间和时间上组织的基因共表达网络的重叠，暗示了该成熟序列的产前编程及其与精神病理的关联。这些发现为青少年皮层成熟提供了一个新颖且多功能的神经发育框架。
items.l1_lead: 青少年皮层的成熟变化与精神病风险密切相关，早熟的感觉区域厚度可预测精神症状，揭示了其与精神病理的潜在联系。
items.l2_summary:
青少年时期的大脑皮层成熟对情感、社交和认知发展至关重要。精神疾病的神经发育理论认为，青少年皮层发展中的细微变化可能与精神病的发生密切相关。为此，我们利用来自青少年大脑认知发展（ABCD）研究的29,482个结构性MRI扫描，分析了11,720名青少年的皮层成熟轮廓和节奏，发现其差异具有可重复性。这些区域轨迹对图像质量的变化表现出稳健性，并与功能专门化的增加相一致。

研究结果显示，早熟的感觉区域的皮层厚度能够预测精神症状，甚至在症状出现前四年就能观察到这一模式，随后这一模式扩展到联结皮层。这一发现表明，青少年皮层的早期变化可能是精神病理风险的重要信号。此外，研究还发现与空间和时间上组织的基因共表达网络的重叠，暗示了该成熟序列的产前编程及其与精神病理的关联。

综上所述，这些发现为青少年皮层成熟提供了一个新颖且多功能的神经发育框架，强调了皮层发育过程中细微变化的重要性及其与精神健康的潜在联系。这一研究不仅为理解青少年精神疾病的早期预警信号提供了新的视角，也为未来的干预和预防措施奠定了基础。

items.title: Serum Electrolyte Concentrations Are Associated With Motor Nerve Conduction Velocity in Children
items.abstract: Axonal action potential propagation critically depends on tightly regulated intra and extracellular electrolyte concentrations and acid base homeostasis. Experimental studies have demonstrated that changes in extracellular sodium, potassium, and calcium concentrations alter axonal excitability and conduction properties. However, it remains unknown whether small variations in electrolyte concentrations within the physiological range are associated with measurable changes in nerve conduction velocity in humans. In this study, data from neurologically healthy children who underwent both nerve conduction studies and blood gas analysis were analyzed to investigate the relationship between electrolyte concentrations and median motor nerve conduction velocity. Nerve conduction velocity was significantly negatively correlated with ionized calcium concentration and positively correlated with sodium concentration, whereas no significant correlation was observed for potassium. In an a priori defined multiple linear regression model, ionized calcium, sodium, and bicarbonate remained significantly associated with nerve conduction velocity after correction for multiple testing. These findings indicate that even small variations in electrolyte concentrations within the physiological range are associated with measurable differences in peripheral nerve conduction velocity and suggest an additional contribution of acid base status to nerve conduction.
items.authors: Broser, P. J.
items.title_zh: 血清电解质浓度与儿童运动神经传导速度的关系
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了神经系统健康的儿童在进行神经传导研究和血气分析后的数据，以探讨电解质浓度与正中运动神经传导速度之间的关系。结果显示，运动神经传导速度与游离钙浓度显著负相关，与钠浓度显著正相关，而与钾浓度无显著相关性。在预先定义的多元线性回归模型中，游离钙、钠和碳酸氢根在多重检验校正后仍与神经传导速度显著相关。这些发现表明，即使在生理范围内电解质浓度的微小变化也与外周神经传导速度的可测量差异相关。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现儿童的运动神经传导速度与游离钙浓度显著负相关，与钠浓度显著正相关，提示电解质浓度微小变化可影响神经传导速度。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨血清电解质浓度与儿童运动神经传导速度之间的关系，分析对象为神经系统健康的儿童。研究通过对神经传导研究和血气分析后的数据进行分析，发现运动神经传导速度与游离钙浓度呈显著负相关关系，而与钠浓度则呈显著正相关，且与钾浓度之间没有显著相关性。这一结果表明，游离钙浓度的增加可能会导致运动神经传导速度的降低，而钠浓度的增加则可能促进运动神经传导速度的提升。

在预先定义的多元线性回归模型中，研究进一步确认了游离钙、钠和碳酸氢根在经过多重检验校正后，仍与神经传导速度显著相关。这一发现强调了即使在生理范围内，电解质浓度的微小变化也可能与外周神经传导速度的可测量差异存在关联。这些结果为理解儿童神经系统的功能提供了新的视角，提示临床工作中应关注电解质平衡对神经传导功能的潜在影响。总之，本研究揭示了血清电解质浓度与儿童运动神经传导速度之间的复杂关系，为今后相关领域的研究提供了重要的理论基础。

items.title: Neural Dissociation of Cognitive Maps and Graphs in the Human Brain
items.abstract: Cognitive maps and graphs offer two distinct ways of organizing knowledge: maps arrange items within a spatial layout, whereas graphs thread them together through experiential transitions. However, spatial proximity and experiential contiguity are typically correlated, and content represented in one format can often be transformed into the other, making their neural representations difficult to disentangle. Here, we orthogonally manipulated Euclidean distance, indexing spatial proximity, and shortest-path distance, indexing experiential contiguity, within the same learned environment. Using fMRI and whole-brain searchlight representational similarity analysis, we identified dissociable representations of these two formats in the human brain. Euclidean distance was represented in the intraparietal sulcus, whereas shortest-path distance was represented in the hippocampal/parahippocampal region and in cortical areas that overlapped substantially with scene-selective regions. ROI analyses further supported the specificity of these representations across regions. Together, these findings provide neural evidence for a dissociation between cognitive maps and cognitive graphs.
items.authors: Xu, Y.; Hinrichs, M. A. B.; Bottini, R.; Doeller, C. F.
items.title_zh: 人脑中认知地图与图的神经分离研究
items.summary_zh: 认知地图和图提供了两种不同的知识组织方式：地图通过空间布局排列项目，而图通过经验转变将项目联系起来。尽管空间接近性和经验连贯性通常相关，但在同一学习环境中，我们通过正交操控欧几里得距离（空间接近性指标）和最短路径距离（经验连贯性指标）来研究它们。使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和全脑搜索光分析，我们在人体大脑中识别出这两种格式的可分离表征。欧几里得距离在顶叶内沟中表征，而最短路径距离则在海马/旁海马区域及与场景选择性区域重叠的皮层区域中表征。ROI分析进一步支持了这些表征在不同区域的特异性。这些发现为认知地图与认知图之间的神经分离提供了证据。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现人脑中认知地图与图的神经表征是可分离的，分别位于不同的大脑区域，支持了两者在知识组织方式上的差异。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了人脑中认知地图（cognitive map）与图（graph）这两种知识组织方式的神经分离。认知地图通过空间布局来排列项目，而图则通过经验转变将项目联系起来。尽管空间接近性与经验连贯性通常是相关的，但研究者在同一学习环境中，通过正交操控欧几里得距离（Euclidean distance，空间接近性指标）和最短路径距离（shortest path distance，经验连贯性指标），深入分析了这两者的神经表征。

研究采用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术和全脑搜索光分析，成功识别出这两种知识格式在大脑中的可分离表征。具体而言，欧几里得距离的表征主要位于顶叶内沟（intraparietal sulcus），而最短路径距离则在海马/旁海马（hippocampal/parahippocampal）区域及与场景选择性区域重叠的皮层区域中被表征。通过感兴趣区域（ROI）分析，进一步验证了这两种表征在不同脑区的特异性。

这些发现为认知地图与认知图之间的神经分离提供了重要证据，表明人脑在处理空间信息和经验信息时，采用了不同的神经机制。这一研究不仅丰富了我们对人类认知结构的理解，也为未来在认知心理学和神经科学领域的研究提供了新的视角和方向。

items.title: A neural circuit algorithm for action grammar
items.abstract: How does the brain generate sequences of discrete elements, such as actions or words, that follow an abstract rule (a grammar)? Motivated by an experiment in which monkeys learned to draw multi-object images according to grammatical rules, we trained a recurrent neural network to generate sequences Am Bn: producing shape A m times, then B n times, or vice versa. Our findings are threefold. First, the network plans the sequence by moving to an initial state encoding m and n along orthogonal directions for upcoming execution. Second, the network repeats each shape by progressing along a shape-specific manifold. Third, transitions from Am to Bn follow parallel trajectories between manifolds across values of n, thus preserving n. Each of these is an experimentally testable prediction. The network generalizes to longer novel sequences by starting further along the same orthogonal directions. These results reveal a neural circuit implementation of a symbolic algorithm for generating rule-based action sequences.
items.authors: Liu, Y.; Tian, L. Y.; Tenenbaum, J. B.; Freiwald, W. A.; Wang, X.-J.
items.title_zh: 神经回路算法生成动作语法
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨大脑如何生成遵循抽象规则（语法）的离散元素序列，如动作或词汇。我们通过训练递归神经网络生成序列Am Bn，即先生成形状A m次，再生成形状B n次，或反之。研究发现，网络通过沿正交方向移动到编码m和n的初始状态来规划序列；其次，网络通过沿特定形状的流形推进来重复每个形状；最后，从Am到Bn的过渡在不同n值之间沿平行轨迹进行，从而保持n的值。这些都是可实验验证的预测。网络能够通过在相同正交方向上更远地开始来推广到更长的新序列。这些结果揭示了生成基于规则的动作序列的符号算法的神经回路实现。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了大脑如何通过神经回路生成遵循抽象规则的动作序列，提供了可实验验证的算法预测。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨大脑如何生成遵循抽象规则（语法）的离散元素序列，例如动作或词汇。研究者通过训练递归神经网络（Recurrent Neural Network, RNN）来生成特定的序列模式，具体为Am Bn，即先生成形状A m次，再生成形状B n次，或反之。研究结果表明，网络在生成序列时，首先通过沿正交方向移动到编码m和n的初始状态来进行序列规划。其次，网络通过沿特定形状的流形推进来重复每个形状，确保生成的序列符合预定的结构。最后，从Am到Bn的过渡在不同n值之间沿平行轨迹进行，这一过程能够保持n的值不变。这些发现不仅为理解大脑如何生成基于规则的动作序列提供了新的视角，还提出了一些可实验验证的预测。

此外，研究还发现，网络能够通过在相同正交方向上更远地开始，从而推广到更长的新序列。这一结果进一步揭示了生成基于规则的动作序列的符号算法在神经回路中的实现机制。通过这些实验，研究者为理解大脑在处理复杂序列生成时的运作方式提供了重要的理论基础和实证支持，强调了神经网络在模拟人类认知过程中的潜力。整体而言，这项研究为神经科学和人工智能领域的交叉研究提供了新的思路，推动了对大脑功能的深入理解。

items.title: Cortical projection neurons exhibit early maturation defects and selective degeneration in a mouse model of spinal muscular atrophy
items.abstract: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is usually considered a lower motor neuron disease; however, growing evidence from both experimental models and clinical studies indicates that SMN deficiency affects the whole CNS, beyond the spinal and brainstem motor system. Here, we investigated the temporal progression and selective vulnerability of cortical projection neurons in the SMN{Delta}7 mouse model at early (P5) and late (P11) symptomatic stages. Combining subtype-specific immunohistochemistry, DiI tracing associated with morphometric reconstruction, and dendritic spine analysis, we identified stage- and subtype-dependent cortical alterations. At P11, corticospinal and infragranular callosal projection neurons were selectively reduced in number and showed marked dendritic remodeling and altered excitatory synaptic organization, whereas corticothalamic neurons and supragranular SATB2-positive populations were comparatively preserved. Notably, cortical abnormalities were already detectable at P5, before overt neuronal loss: indeed, corticospinal neurons exhibited reduced soma size and dendritic complexity, while dendritic spine density remained preserved, but spine morphology was shifted toward immature phenotypes. These early maturation defects persisted during disease progression and preceded the reduction in spine density observed at P11. Together, our findings identify cortical projection neurons as selectively vulnerable to constitutive SMN deficiency and suggest that impaired neuronal and synaptic maturation represents an early feature of cortical pathology preceding subtype-specific neurodegeneration. These results expand the pathophysiological spectrum of SMA beyond lower motor neurons and highlight early brain alterations as a potential component of disease progression.
items.authors: Schellino, R.; La Rocca, F.; Iezzi, G.; Caretto, A.; Boido, M.; Vercelli, A.
items.title_zh: 皮层投射神经元在脊髓肌萎缩小鼠模型中早期成熟缺陷与选择性退化
items.summary_zh: 脊髓肌萎缩症（SMA）通常被视为下运动神经元疾病，但越来越多的证据表明，SMN缺乏影响整个中枢神经系统。本文研究了SMN{Delta}7小鼠模型中皮层投射神经元在早期（P5）和晚期（P11）症状阶段的时间进展和选择性脆弱性。通过亚型特异性免疫组化、DiI追踪及形态重建和树突棘分析，我们发现了阶段和亚型依赖的皮层改变。在P11时，皮层脊髓和下颗粒层胼胝体投射神经元数量显著减少，且表现出明显的树突重塑和兴奋性突触组织改变，而皮层丘脑神经元和上颗粒层SATB2阳性群体相对保存。值得注意的是，皮层异常在P5时已可检测到，早于明显的神经元丧失，皮层脊髓神经元表现出细胞体大小和树突复杂性减少，树突棘密度保持，但棘体形态向未成熟表型转变。这些早期成熟缺陷在疾病进展中持续存在，并在P11时观察到的棘体密度减少之前。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，脊髓肌萎缩小鼠模型中皮层投射神经元在早期阶段即出现成熟缺陷，随后选择性退化，提示SMN缺乏对中枢神经系统的广泛影响。
items.l2_summary:
脊髓肌萎缩症（SMA）被普遍认为是一种下运动神经元疾病，但研究表明，SMN（生存运动神经元）缺乏对整个中枢神经系统产生影响。本文探讨了SMN{Delta}7小鼠模型中皮层投射神经元在早期（P5）和晚期（P11）症状阶段的时间进展及其选择性脆弱性。研究通过亚型特异性免疫组化、DiI追踪、形态重建和树突棘分析，揭示了皮层神经元在不同发展阶段的变化。

在P11时，研究发现皮层脊髓和下颗粒层胼胝体投射神经元的数量显著减少，且这些神经元表现出明显的树突重塑和兴奋性突触组织的改变。相比之下，皮层丘脑神经元和上颗粒层SATB2阳性群体相对保存，显示出不同亚型神经元的选择性脆弱性。更为重要的是，皮层的异常变化在P5时就已可被检测到，早于明显的神经元丧失。在这一阶段，皮层脊髓神经元表现出细胞体大小和树突复杂性的减少，虽然树突棘密度保持不变，但棘体的形态却向未成熟表型转变。这些早期成熟缺陷在疾病进展过程中持续存在，并在P11时观察到的棘体密度减少之前就已显现。

综上所述，研究揭示了SMA小鼠模型中皮层投射神经元的早期成熟缺陷及其选择性退化的特征，强调了在疾病进展中，皮层神经元的变化可能在早期阶段就已开始，为理解SMA的病理机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: ATP1A3 dysfunction alters excitability and developmental trajectory of human neurons in alternating hemiplegia of childhood
items.abstract: Pathogenic variants in ATP1A3, encoding the neuronal Na/K-ATPase, are associated with a spectrum of neuro-developmental disorders including alternating hemiplegia of childhood (AHC). ATP1A3 is expressed throughout the cortex during early development, and later becomes enriched in GABAergic neurons. Here, we interrogated the underlying mechanisms and neurophysiological consequences of a recurrent AHC-associated variant (ATP1A3-G947R) in human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) derived glutamatergic and GABAergic neu-rons. We found that glutamatergic and GABAergic AHC neurons exhibited smaller ouabain-sensitive pump cur-rents compared to isogenic mutation-corrected control neurons. This impairment of pump function correlated with a depolarized potassium reversal potential, lower intracellular potassium concentration, and depolarized resting membrane potential for both cell types compared to isogenic control neurons. Additionally, using a Na+ sensitive dye, we observed that AHC neurons had a higher basal intracellular Na+ concentration that recovered more slowly following Na+ loading compared to isogenic control neurons. As an additional consequence of impaired pump function and abnormal Na+ dynamics, glutamatergic and GABAergic AHC neurons were more prone to depolarization block. Finally, the time course by which GABA neurotransmission switches from excita-tory to inhibitory was delayed in glutamatergic AHC neurons compared to isogenic controls.
