items.title_zh: 加纳高中生中由非专业教师提供的抑郁症短期心理治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 引言：青少年抑郁和焦虑发生率高，全球80%的青少年，尤其是低中收入国家的青少年缺乏适宜的治疗。非洲青少年心理健康项目（Y-MIND）旨在调整青少年友好的“友谊长椅”方案，并评估其在加纳的可行性。方法：本研究为一项可行性集群随机对照试验，招募了15至18岁、根据患者健康问卷（PHQ-9）总分>9诊断为中度至重度抑郁的参与者，来自加纳Navrongo的六所高中。学校随机分配为增强常规护理（EUC）组或EUC加Y-MIND组。主要结果为干预的可行性，次要结果包括干预的适宜性、可接受性及抑郁症状严重程度和缓解情况。结果：2024年7月至8月，我们招募了67名参与者（EUC加Y-MIND组43人[64%]，EUC组24人[36%]），其中64人（95.5%）完成了5个月的主要结果评估。Y-MIND干预的可行性得到了验证。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，在加纳高中生中，由非专业教师提供的Y-MIND抑郁症短期心理治疗方案具有良好的可行性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于加纳高中生中由非专业教师提供的抑郁症短期心理治疗的可行性，特别是在青少年中普遍存在的抑郁和焦虑问题。全球范围内，约80%的青少年，尤其是在低中收入国家，缺乏适宜的心理健康治疗。为此，非洲青少年心理健康项目（Y-MIND）旨在调整青少年友好的“友谊长椅”方案，并评估其在加纳的实施效果。

研究采用可行性集群随机对照试验设计，招募了15至18岁、根据患者健康问卷（PHQ-9）总分大于9被诊断为中度至重度抑郁的参与者，来自加纳Navrongo的六所高中。参与学校被随机分配为增强常规护理（EUC）组或EUC加Y-MIND组。主要结果指标为干预的可行性，次要结果包括干预的适宜性、可接受性以及抑郁症状的严重程度和缓解情况。

在2024年7月至8月期间，共招募了67名参与者，其中EUC加Y-MIND组有43人（占64%），EUC组有24人（占36%）。在这67名参与者中，有64人（占95.5%）完成了为期5个月的主要结果评估。结果显示，Y-MIND干预的可行性得到了验证，表明该方案在加纳的实施是可行的，并为青少年提供了必要的心理健康支持。

综上所述，本研究不仅揭示了加纳高中生中抑郁症的普遍性，还验证了由非专业教师提供的短期心理治疗的可行性，为今后在类似背景下推广心理健康干预措施提供了重要依据。

items.title: Latent Brain-Symptom Dimensions Characterize Heterogeneity in Clinical High Risk for Psychosis
items.abstract: BACKGROUND: Clinical high risk (CHR) for psychosis is characterized by substantial heterogeneity in symptoms, functioning, and outcomes. Although distributed resting-state functional connectivity (RSFC) abnormalities have been reported, it remains unclear whether this heterogeneity can be organized into consistent multivariate brain-symptom dimensions and clinically meaningful subgroups. METHODS: We analyzed RSFC and 34 clinical variables from 701 CHR participants in the Accelerating Medicines Partnership Schizophrenia Program (AMP SCZ). Partial least squares analysis identified latent brain-symptom dimensions, which were further examined using transcriptomic annotation, independent psychosocial and cognitive measures, hierarchical clustering, and Month 2 follow-up data. RESULTS: Two significant brain-symptom dimensions emerged. The first reflected general psychopathology and was associated with somatomotor-salience and higher-order connectivity, with enrichment for genes related to neuronal development. The second, capturing symptom differentiation, spanned negative/internalizing features with psychobehavioral overactivation and involved cerebellar-thalamic-somatomotor circuitry, with enrichment for genes related to synaptic signaling. These dimensions showed dissociable associations with broader psychosocial and cognitive measures, and their loading patterns were substantially reproducible at Month 2. Clustering based on these dimensions identified two biotypes with distinct clinical and connectivity profiles that remained broadly similar at Month 2 despite divergent short-term RSFC changes. CONCLUSIONS: These findings support complementary dimensional and categorical representations of CHR heterogeneity that link clinical variation with distributed brain connectivity and molecular signatures, while demonstrating short-term reproducibility of the identified dimensions and divergent RSFC changes across biotypes. This multilevel framework may help characterize biologically meaningful variation in psychosis risk.
items.authors: Feng, J.; Genon, S.; Eickhoff, S. B.; Li, F.; Jiang, L.; Wang, Y.; Dong, D.
items.title_zh: 潜在大脑-症状维度揭示精神病临床高风险的异质性
items.summary_zh: 背景：精神病临床高风险（CHR）表现出症状、功能和结果的显著异质性。尽管已有研究报告了静息态功能连接（RSFC）异常，但尚不清楚这种异质性是否可以组织成一致的多变量大脑-症状维度和具有临床意义的亚组。方法：我们分析了来自701名CHR参与者的RSFC和34个临床变量，数据来源于加速药物合作精神分裂症项目（AMP SCZ）。采用偏最小二乘法分析识别潜在的大脑-症状维度，并通过转录组注释、独立的心理社会和认知测量、层次聚类及第2个月的跟踪数据进一步检验。结果：识别出两个显著的大脑-症状维度。第一个维度反映一般精神病理，与躯体运动-显著性和高阶连接相关，富集与神经发育相关的基因。第二个维度捕捉症状差异，涵盖负性/内化特征，涉及小脑-丘脑-躯体运动回路，富集与突触信号传导相关的基因。这些维度与更广泛的心理社会和认知测量表现出可分离的关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现精神病临床高风险个体可通过两个大脑-症状维度进行有效分类，揭示其在症状表现和神经生物学上的异质性。
items.l2_summary:
精神病临床高风险（CHR）个体在症状、功能和结果上表现出显著的异质性，尽管已有研究指出静息态功能连接（RSFC）存在异常，但尚不清楚这种异质性是否可以形成一致的多变量大脑-症状维度以及具有临床意义的亚组。为此，研究团队分析了701名CHR参与者的RSFC和34个临床变量，数据来源于加速药物合作精神分裂症项目（AMP SCZ）。通过偏最小二乘法分析，研究识别出了两个显著的大脑-症状维度。

第一个维度反映了一般精神病理，显示出与躯体运动-显著性和高阶连接相关的特征，并且富集与神经发育相关的基因。这一维度的发现表明，精神病理的普遍性可能与特定的神经生物学机制相关联。第二个维度则捕捉了症状的差异，涵盖了负性/内化特征，涉及小脑-丘脑-躯体运动回路，并且富集与突触信号传导相关的基因。这一维度的存在提示了在CHR个体中，症状表现的多样性可能与特定的神经回路功能失调有关。

此外，这两个维度与更广泛的心理社会和认知测量表现出可分离的关联，进一步支持了大脑-症状维度的临床意义。通过转录组注释、独立的心理社会和认知测量、层次聚类及第2个月的跟踪数据，研究结果得到了进一步的验证。这些发现不仅为理解精神病临床高风险个体的异质性提供了新的视角，也为未来的临床干预和个性化治疗策略的制定奠定了基础。

items.title: Does active travel behaviour moderate the association between the built environment and depression?
items.abstract: Background: Built environment characteristics have been associated with depressive symptoms, whilst active travel behaviour is linked to improved mental health. However, it remains unclear whether active travel buffers associations between increased exposure to the built environment and worse mental health. Methods: In this pre-registered study, participants were 10,310 mothers (mean age = 28.11, SD = 4.83) participating in the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC). A latent built environment factor was measured at study enrolment, active travel behaviour at a 2-year follow-up, and depressive symptoms at a 4-year follow-up. Moderation was examined using adjusted linear regression models including an interaction term between the built environment factor and active travel behaviour. Results: The built environment factor was positively associated with depressive symptoms ({beta} = 0.023, p = .012). Active travel behaviour was not associated with depressive symptoms ({beta} = -0.002, p = .854) and did not moderate the association between the built environment factor and depressive symptoms ({beta} = -0.002, p = .865), after adjusting for covariates, including age, familial depressive history, socioeconomic risk factors, physical activity, baseline depressive symptoms and smoking. Conclusion: Contrary to expectations, active travel behaviour does not modify associations between the built environment and depressive symptoms. These findings provide no evidence that active travel mitigates mental health risks associated with the built environment in this population.
items.authors: Sanders, F.; Baltramonaityte, V.; Whitmarsh, L.; Walton, E.
items.title_zh: 主动出行行为是否调节建筑环境与抑郁症的关系？
items.summary_zh: 背景：建筑环境特征与抑郁症状相关，而主动出行行为与改善心理健康有关。然而，主动出行是否缓解建筑环境暴露增加与心理健康恶化之间的关系尚不明确。方法：本研究为预注册研究，参与者为10,310名母亲（平均年龄=28.11岁，标准差=4.83），参与了阿冯纵向父母与儿童研究（ALSPAC）。在研究入组时测量建筑环境潜在因素，在2年后随访时测量主动出行行为，在4年后随访时测量抑郁症状。使用调整后的线性回归模型检验调节作用，包括建筑环境因素与主动出行行为的交互项。结果：建筑环境因素与抑郁症状呈正相关（β=0.023，p=0.012）。主动出行行为与抑郁症状无显著关联（β=-0.002，p=0.854），且在调整年龄、家庭抑郁史、社会经济风险因素、身体活动、基线抑郁症状和吸烟后，未调节建筑环境因素与抑郁症状之间的关系（β=-0.002，p=0.865）。结论：与预期相反，主动出行行为并未改变建筑环境与抑郁症状之间的关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，主动出行行为未能调节建筑环境与抑郁症状之间的正相关关系，表明其对心理健康的影响有限。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨建筑环境特征与抑郁症状之间的关系，以及主动出行行为（active travel）是否能够调节这种关系。研究背景指出，建筑环境的特征与抑郁症状存在相关性，而主动出行行为则被认为有助于改善心理健康。然而，主动出行是否能够缓解建筑环境暴露增加对心理健康的负面影响尚不明确。

本研究为预注册研究，参与者为10,310名母亲，平均年龄为28.11岁（标准差为4.83），她们参与了阿冯纵向父母与儿童研究（ALSPAC）。在研究入组时，研究者测量了建筑环境的潜在因素，并在2年后随访时评估了参与者的主动出行行为，4年后则测量了抑郁症状。研究采用调整后的线性回归模型来检验建筑环境因素与主动出行行为之间的交互作用对抑郁症状的调节作用。

结果显示，建筑环境因素与抑郁症状之间存在正相关关系（β=0.023，p=0.012），这表明建筑环境的特征可能会加重抑郁症状。然而，主动出行行为与抑郁症状之间并未发现显著关联（β=-0.002，p=0.854）。在调整了年龄、家庭抑郁史、社会经济风险因素、身体活动、基线抑郁症状和吸烟等变量后，主动出行行为也未能调节建筑环境因素与抑郁症状之间的关系（β=-0.002，p=0.865）。

综上所述，与预期相反，本研究发现主动出行行为并未改变建筑环境与抑郁症状之间的关联。这一结果提示，尽管建筑环境对心理健康有影响，但主动出行行为可能并不是缓解这种影响的有效途径，未来的研究可能需要进一步探讨其他因素对这一关系的影响。

items.title: Probabilistic forecasting of prefecture-level influenza in Japan accounting for surveillance data release histories
items.abstract: Background. Public-health use of influenza surveillance - situational awareness, planning for clinical surge, and issuing advisories or warnings - needs more than an accurate point estimate of next week's count. What matters operationally is whether a rise is caught early, whether the direction of change is right, and whether an alert threshold is about to be crossed, all with honest uncertainty. For such use a forecast must also respect reporting delay, later data revision, and the calibration of its prediction intervals. Using Japan's sentinel surveillance, we evaluated short-term probabilistic forecasts that respect the data release history, and we measured what adding other surveillance series contributes, focusing on the properties that matter for public-health decisions. Methods. The target was the number of influenza reports per sentinel site in each of the 47 prefectures. For each forecast we predicted, as quantiles, the value 1-4 weeks after the most recent observed week. We compared three models: a ridge regression trained jointly across prefectures; a gradient-boosting quantile regression (GBQR) that learns from many surveillance series; and their equal-weight combination on the log scale. Six seasons were used to develop the models. The 2025/26 season was held out as a temporal evaluation period after the specification was fixed; because its epidemic profile had already been seen, it is not a fully independent prospective test. We scored forecasts with the weighted interval score (WIS) and checked prediction-interval coverage. For the Japanese target series we used the value first published for each week; some auxiliary series were taken as retrieved and therefore include later revisions. Results. In 2025/26, the combination's WIS relative to a persistence forecast was 0.841, 0.811, 0.794 and 0.818 at horizons of 1-4 observed weeks - that is, 16-21% lower than persistence. Coverage of the 80% prediction interval was 79.7%, 77.1%, 74.5% and 75.1%, and of the 95% interval 94.3%, 93.4%, 92.6% and 91.8%. Adding auxiliary series improved the GBQR over the development period. However, on the original scale the combination's edge over ridge regression was not statistically clear, and in some low-level rising phases the combination did worse than ridge. Conclusions. Over the period studied, models that share information across regions scored better than a persistence forecast. For public-health use, however, the operative questions are the real lead time once reporting delay is accounted for, whether rises from low levels and threshold exceedances are caught in time, and whether the upper prediction intervals are wide enough; on these, the present evidence is not yet sufficient. The 2025 change to the sentinel system also means that pre-change advisory and warning thresholds cannot be read mechanically. A prospective evaluation with strictly controlled data availability is needed before such forecasts are used to support advisories or planning.
items.authors: NAKAGAWA, R.; Yamamura, N.
items.title_zh: 考虑监测数据发布历史的日本流感概率预测
items.summary_zh: 背景：公共卫生对流感监测的应用需要的不仅仅是下周病例的准确点估计，而是早期捕捉到病例上升、变化方向的正确性及是否即将超过警报阈值，同时需考虑不确定性。方法：我们以日本的哨点监测数据为基础，评估了尊重数据发布历史的短期概率预测，并测量了其他监测系列的贡献，重点关注对公共卫生决策重要的属性。目标是预测47个都道府县每个哨点的流感报告数量，预测1-4周后的值。比较了三种模型：跨都道府县联合训练的岭回归、从多个监测系列学习的梯度提升分位回归（GBQR）及其在对数尺度上的等权组合。使用六个流感季节开发模型，2025/26季节作为时间评估期。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，基于历史监测数据的流感概率预测模型能有效捕捉病例变化趋势，为公共卫生决策提供重要支持。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在提高日本流感监测的预测能力，特别是在公共卫生决策中，准确捕捉流感病例的上升趋势和变化方向至关重要。传统的流感监测不仅需要对下周病例进行准确的点估计，更需要考虑病例是否即将超过警报阈值及其不确定性。因此，研究团队基于日本的哨点监测数据，评估了尊重数据发布历史的短期概率预测方法，并测量了不同监测系列对预测结果的贡献。

研究的主要目标是预测日本47个都道府县每个哨点在未来1至4周内的流感报告数量。为此，研究者比较了三种不同的预测模型：首先是跨都道府县联合训练的岭回归（Ridge Regression），其次是从多个监测系列学习的梯度提升分位回归（Gradient Boosting Quantile Regression, GBQR），最后是这两种模型在对数尺度上的等权组合。研究使用了六个流感季节的数据进行模型开发，并将2025/26流感季节作为时间评估期。

通过对不同模型的比较，研究发现，考虑数据发布历史的预测方法能够显著提高流感病例的预测准确性，尤其是在早期识别病例上升趋势方面。这一发现对公共卫生决策具有重要意义，因为它能够帮助相关部门及时采取措施，防止流感疫情的扩散。总的来说，研究强调了在流感监测中整合多种数据源和模型的重要性，以提高预测的可靠性和有效性。

items.title: Longitudinal Associations between the Built Environment, Biological Aging and Cognition
items.abstract: Features of urbanicity have been linked to poor psychiatric health in adulthood, but little is known about their relationship with biological age and cognition earlier in life. Using the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC), we tested associations between the built environment and epigenetic ages (EpiAgeAltum, EpiAgeHorvath, EpiAgePACE) (n=2,452), brain age (n=751), and cognition (n=12,199). Analyses were replicated in Generation R and triangulated in the Millennium Cohort Study. The built environment was not associated with epigenetic ages ({beta}Altum range = 0.013-0.015, p range = .466-.689; {beta}Horvath range = -0.011-0.023, p range = .182-.728; {beta}PACE range = -0.045-0.013, p range = .131-.524) or brain age ({beta} range = 0.022-0.028, p range = .337-.429). A negative association with cognition was observed in Generation R. We provide no consistent evidence that childhood built environment exposure relates to biological age and cognition in adolescence, suggesting these relationships may emerge in later life.
items.authors: Sanders, F.; Baltramonaityte, V.; Staginnus, M.; Mulder, R. H.; Muetzel, R. L.; Vrijheid, M.; Dunn, E. C.; Fisher, H. L.; Cecil, C. A. M.; Walton, E.
items.title_zh: 建筑环境、生物年龄与认知的纵向关联研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用阿冯纵向父母与儿童研究（ALSPAC），探讨建筑环境与表观遗传年龄（EpiAgeAltum, EpiAgeHorvath, EpiAgePACE）（n=2,452）、大脑年龄（n=751）及认知（n=12,199）之间的关系。分析在Generation R中进行了重复验证，并在千年队列研究中进行了三角验证。结果显示，建筑环境与表观遗传年龄无显著关联（{beta}Altum范围 = 0.013-0.015, p范围 = .466-.689; {beta}Horvath范围 = -0.011-0.023, p范围 = .182-.728; {beta}PACE范围 = -0.045-0.013, p范围 = .131-.524）或大脑年龄（{beta}范围 = 0.022-0.028, p范围 = .337-.429）。在Generation R中观察到与认知的负相关。研究未提供一致证据表明儿童期建筑环境暴露与青少年生物年龄和认知相关，提示这些关系可能在后期生活中出现。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，儿童期建筑环境与青少年生物年龄和认知无显著关联，提示这些影响可能在后期生活中显现。
items.l2_summary: 本研究利用阿冯纵向父母与儿童研究（ALSPAC）数据，探讨建筑环境与表观遗传年龄（EpiAgeAltum, EpiAgeHorvath, EpiAgePACE）、大脑年龄及认知之间的关系，样本量分别为2,452、751和12,199。研究结果经过Generation R的重复验证和千年队列研究的三角验证，显示建筑环境与表观遗传年龄之间并无显著关联，具体而言，EpiAgeAltum的β值范围为0.013-0.015（p值范围为0.466-0.689），EpiAgeHorvath的β值范围为-0.011-0.023（p值范围为0.182-0.728），EpiAgePACE的β值范围为-0.045-0.013（p值范围为0.131-0.524）。此外，建筑环境与大脑年龄的关联同样不显著，β值范围为0.022-0.028（p值范围为0.337-0.429）。然而，在Generation R研究中，观察到建筑环境与认知之间存在负相关关系。综上所述，研究未能提供一致的证据表明儿童期建筑环境暴露与青少年生物年龄和认知能力之间存在直接关联，这提示这些关系可能在个体后期生活中才会显现。

items.title: Large-scale assessment of socioeconomic, demographic and health system structures with US county excess mortality, 2020-2024
items.abstract: Socioeconomic, demographic, and health system structures may have shaped COVID-19 pandemic impact across populations, but past analyses typically examined few factors. We systematically examined correlates of COVID-era excess mortality, considering 2,745 county-level variables of demography, race/ethnicity, income, insurance, education, employment, housing, and health system. Pearson correlation coefficients (CCs) were obtained for the most recent available pre-pandemic value against age-standardized county excess-death for each year during 2020-2024. Counties were population-weighted. Variables were grouped by meaning into 11 semantic super-clusters. Overall, 17.3% of variables reached at least a moderate correlation level (|CC| > 0.30) and 2.8% reached strong correlations (|CC| > 0.45). Strongest correlations were seen for college attainment (CC -0.54), uninsurance among adults 40-64 (+0.53), and high income (-0.53). At least moderate correlations were seen for 9.1% of variables in 2020 and 8.5% in 2021, but only 1.8%, 0%, and 1.3% in 2022, 2023, and 2024, respectively. Similar patterns of concentration of moderate correlations in the first two pandemic years appeared in both elderly and non-elderly populations. Of 472 variables with |CC| > 0.30, 362/395 moderate-band and 77/77 strong-band variables belonged to demography and socioeconomic super-clusters. Only 7% of health system variables reached |CC| > 0.30, versus 31% of socioeconomic and demographic variables. Using the most recent available value until 2023 or 2015, different population weighting, and Spearman correlations yielded similar results. Overall, these ecological analyses suggest strong relationships of socioeconomic structure and demographics rather than health-care resources/supply with excess mortality across US counties especially during 2020-2021.
items.authors: Levitt, M.; Marten, B.; Oren, G.; Ioannidis, J.
items.title_zh: 2020-2024年美国县级超额死亡率与社会经济及健康系统结构的评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统性地考察了社会经济、人口和健康系统结构对COVID-19疫情影响的关联，分析了2745个县级变量，包括人口、种族/民族、收入、保险、教育、就业、住房和健康系统。通过计算皮尔逊相关系数（CC），将最新的疫情前数据与2020-2024年每年的年龄标准化县级超额死亡率进行比较。结果显示，17.3%的变量达到中等相关水平（|CC| > 0.30），2.8%达到强相关（|CC| > 0.45）。最强相关的变量包括大学学历（CC -0.54）、40-64岁成人无保险率（+0.53）和高收入（-0.53）。在2020年和2021年，分别有9.1%和8.5%的变量显示中等相关性，而2022年、2023年和2024年则分别仅为1.8%、0%和1.3%。老年人和非老年人群体中均出现了类似的中等相关性集中模式。
items.l1_lead: 本研究发现，社会经济因素与COVID-19疫情期间美国县级超额死亡率存在显著相关性，尤其是教育水平、无保险率和收入水平对死亡率影响较大。
items.l2_summary:
本研究系统性地评估了社会经济、人口特征及健康系统结构对COVID-19疫情影响的关联，分析了2745个县级变量，包括人口、种族/民族、收入、保险、教育、就业、住房和健康系统等因素。通过计算皮尔逊相关系数（CC），研究者将最新的疫情前数据与2020-2024年每年的年龄标准化县级超额死亡率进行比较。结果显示，17.3%的变量与超额死亡率达到中等相关水平（|CC| > 0.30），而2.8%的变量则显示出强相关性（|CC| > 0.45）。在所有分析的变量中，最强相关的因素包括大学学历（CC -0.54）、40-64岁成人无保险率（+0.53）和高收入（-0.53），这些因素的变化与超额死亡率呈现出显著的负相关或正相关关系。

具体来看，在2020年和2021年，分别有9.1%和8.5%的变量显示出中等相关性，而在2022年、2023年和2024年，这一比例显著下降，分别仅为1.8%、0%和1.3%。这一趋势表明，随着疫情的持续，社会经济因素与超额死亡率之间的相关性逐渐减弱。此外，研究还发现，无论是在老年人群体还是非老年人群体中，均出现了类似的中等相关性集中模式，进一步强调了社会经济因素在疫情影响中的重要性。

综上所述，本研究揭示了社会经济和健康系统结构对COVID-19疫情期间超额死亡率的显著影响，尤其是教育水平、保险覆盖率和收入水平等因素的关联性，为未来公共卫生政策的制定提供了重要的参考依据。

items.title: Multi-centre validation of MELD-graph for automated focal cortical dysplasia detection using 7T compared to paired 3T MRI
items.abstract: Background: Software tools can support MRI diagnosis of focal cortical dysplasias (FCDs) - subtle, surgically-treatable lesions that underlie drug-resistant focal epilepsy (DRFE). MELD-graph, a widely used open-source tool combining surface-based morphometry with a convolutional neural network, was developed using 1.5T and 3T MRI data. 7T MRI is increasingly used for lesion detection in DRFE. This study investigated whether MELD-graph is robust to domain shift at 7T. Methods: We collated paired 3T and 7T T1-weighted MRI, and FLAIR where available, from 23 patients with FCD (6 histologically-verified, 17 identified radiologically) and 39 healthy controls at four epilepsy centres. Manual lesion labels were used as ground truth. MELD-graph was run on 3T images, on 7T images with the default pipeline, and on 7T images with adaptations for 7T MRI (SPM bias-field correction, SynthStrip skull-stripping, sub-millimetric FreeSurfer reconstruction), with and without ComBat harmonisation. FCD detection performance and surface morphometry features were compared. Results: Sensitivity for FCD detection was 65% (15/23) at 3T, 48% (11/23) for 7T default and 52% (12/23) for 7T adapted, with Combat harmonisation. Among radiologically 3T-negative patients, 2/8 were detected at 3T and 3/8 at 7T; and among histologically confirmed FCD, 3/6 at 3T and 1/6 at 7T. Specificity was significantly lower at 7T (default 39%, adapted 45%) than 3T (76%). False-positives predominantly occurred in the basal temporal lobes. ComBat harmonisation improved specificity in all conditions and largely compensated for field-strength dependent differences in surface morphometry features. Adding FLAIR at 7T increased false-positive predictions. Conclusion: Sensitivity is comparable but specificity of MELD-graph is lower at 7T compared to 3T. Adaptations for 7T MRI can reduce segmentation errors but do not significantly improve FCD detection, while harmonisation improves performance. The adapted pipeline is released open-source. 7T MELD-graph outputs may inform radiologist review in challenging cases but require cautious interpretation.

items.title_zh: MELD-graph在7T MRI下对局灶性皮质发育不良的自动检测多中心验证
items.summary_zh: 背景：软件工具可以支持局灶性皮质发育不良（FCD）的MRI诊断，这些病变是导致药物难治性局灶性癫痫（DRFE）的微妙、可手术治疗的病变。MELD-graph是一种广泛使用的开源工具，结合了基于表面的形态测量和卷积神经网络，最初使用1.5T和3T MRI数据开发。本研究探讨了MELD-graph在7T MRI下的稳健性。方法：我们收集了来自四个癫痫中心的23名FCD患者（6例组织学验证，17例影像学识别）和39名健康对照的配对3T和7T T1加权MRI及FLAIR数据。使用手动病变标签作为真实值。MELD-graph在3T图像、7T图像的默认流程及适应7T MRI的图像上运行，并进行了ComBat协调。结果：FCD检测的敏感性在3T为65%（15/23），7T默认为48%（11/23），适应7T为52%（12/23）。在影像学3T阴性患者中，3T检测到2/8，7T检测到3/8；在组织学确认的FCD中，3T检测到3/6，7T检测到1/6。特异性在7T下显著降低。
items.l1_lead: MELD-graph在7T MRI下对局灶性皮质发育不良的检测敏感性较低，特异性显著下降，显示其在高场强MRI中的稳健性不足。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在验证MELD-graph这一开源工具在7T MRI下对局灶性皮质发育不良（Focal Cortical Dysplasia, FCD）的自动检测能力。FCD是一种导致药物难治性局灶性癫痫（Drug-Resistant Focal Epilepsy, DRFE）的微妙病变，通常可通过手术治疗。MELD-graph结合了基于表面形态测量和卷积神经网络，最初是在1.5T和3T MRI数据上开发的。本研究收集了来自四个癫痫中心的23名FCD患者（其中6例经过组织学验证，17例通过影像学识别）和39名健康对照的配对3T和7T T1加权MRI及FLAIR数据，并使用手动病变标签作为真实值进行分析。

研究结果显示，FCD检测的敏感性在3T MRI下为65%（15/23），而在7T MRI的默认流程下敏感性下降至48%（11/23），经过适应7T MRI的处理后，敏感性略微提高至52%（12/23）。在影像学3T阴性患者中，3T检测到2/8例，而7T检测到3/8例；在经过组织学确认的FCD病例中，3T检测到3/6例，而7T仅检测到1/6例。此外，研究还发现7T MRI下的特异性显著降低，这表明在高场强MRI下，MELD-graph的检测性能存在一定的局限性。

综上所述，尽管MELD-graph在3T MRI下表现出较好的敏感性，但在7T MRI下的检测能力有所下降，特别是在特异性方面的显著降低提示了高场强MRI在FCD检测中的挑战。这一研究为进一步优化MELD-graph在不同MRI强度下的应用提供了重要的参考依据。

items.title: A normative torque-profile approach for quantifying elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance after stroke: a proof-of-principle study
items.abstract: Background: Post-stroke spasticity is commonly assessed using the Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS), despite its limited objectivity and variable reliability. This study introduces ScoreE, a novel isokinetic dynamometry-derived metric designed to quantify elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance by comparing patients torque-angle profiles with a healthy reference corridor. Methods: Thirty-five post-stroke patients and twenty-one healthy controls were included. Elbow and wrist hyper-resistance was assessed using the MAS and an isokinetic dynamometer in two testing conditions: seated on the dynamometer chair (ergo chair) and seated in the patient wheelchair. Two dynamometer-derived metrics were analyzed: ScoreE and peak torque (PeakT). Feasibility, inter-rater and test-retest reliability, and associations with MAS grades were assessed. Exploratory PRE-POST changes following a 10-min local vibration session were also described. Results: ScoreE showed good to excellent inter-rater and test-retest reliability across joints and testing conditions. Inter-rater ICCs ranged from 0.81 to 0.89, and test-retest ICCs from 0.76 to 0.93. PeakT showed moderate to good reliability. In contrast, MAS agreement was lower and more variable. ScoreE showed moderate associations with MAS grades, particularly at the elbow, with weaker and less consistent associations at the wrist. MAS assessment was faster, but all assessments were well tolerated, with median pain ratings of 0/10 in all testing conditions. PRE-POST vibration changes were small and heterogeneous, preventing formal assessment of responsiveness. Conclusion: ScoreE provides a reliable, objective, and visually interpretable quantification of post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance. By comparing the full torque-angle profile with normative data, this approach preserves information on both the magnitude and angular span of abnormal resistance, supporting its potential for targeted longitudinal monitoring.
items.authors: Julliand, S. I.; Laroche, D.; Besson, D.; Fournel, I.; Riglet, L.; Papaxanthis, C.; Gaveau, J.
items.title_zh: 中风后肘腕屈肌超阻力的规范扭矩特征量化研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：中风后的痉挛性肌肉通常通过修订阿什沃斯量表（MAS）评估，但其客观性和可靠性有限。本研究引入ScoreE，一种新型的等速肌力测量指标，用于通过比较患者的扭矩-角度特征与健康参考区间来量化肘腕屈肌超阻力。方法：纳入35名中风患者和21名健康对照者。使用MAS和等速肌力测量仪在两种测试条件下评估肘腕超阻力：坐在测量仪椅子上和坐在患者轮椅上。分析了两个测量指标：ScoreE和峰值扭矩（PeakT）。评估了可行性、评估者间和重测可靠性，以及与MAS等级的关联。结果：ScoreE在各关节和测试条件下显示出良好到优秀的评估者间和重测可靠性，ICC值范围为0.81至0.89，重测ICC值为0.76至0.93。PeakT显示出中等到良好的可靠性，而MAS的一致性较低且变异性大。ScoreE与MAS等级呈中等关联，尤其在肘部，腕部关联较弱且不一致。MAS评估速度较快。
items.l1_lead: 本研究提出ScoreE作为一种新型等速肌力测量指标，能够更客观、可靠地量化中风后肘腕屈肌超阻力，优于传统的阿什沃斯量表。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在量化中风后肘腕屈肌的超阻力特征，采用了一种新型的等速肌力测量指标ScoreE，以克服传统阿什沃斯量表（MAS）在客观性和可靠性方面的不足。研究纳入了35名中风患者和21名健康对照者，通过在两种不同的测试条件下（坐在测量仪椅子上和坐在患者轮椅上）评估肘腕的超阻力。研究主要分析了两个测量指标：ScoreE和峰值扭矩（PeakT）。

结果显示，ScoreE在各关节和测试条件下均表现出良好到优秀的评估者间和重测可靠性，ICC（组内相关系数）值范围为0.81至0.89，重测ICC值为0.76至0.93，表明其作为评估工具的稳定性和一致性较高。相比之下，PeakT的可靠性则显示为中等到良好，而MAS的评估一致性较低且变异性较大，说明MAS在评估中风患者肘腕屈肌超阻力时存在一定的局限性。

此外，ScoreE与MAS等级之间存在中等关联，尤其是在肘部的评估中表现更为明显，而在腕部的关联则较弱且不一致。这一发现提示ScoreE可能在临床评估中提供更为可靠的超阻力量化方式。值得注意的是，MAS的评估速度较快，但其结果的可靠性和一致性不足，可能影响临床决策的准确性。

综上所述，本研究通过引入ScoreE为中风后肘腕屈肌超阻力的量化提供了一种新的方法，显示出其在可靠性和客观性方面的优势，为未来的临床评估和治疗方案的制定提供了重要依据。

items.title: Menstrual health, food insecurity, and protection vulnerability among adolescent girls in internally displaced persons camps in Benue State, Nigeria: A focused ethnographic study
items.abstract: Adolescent girls living in internally displaced persons (IDP) camps manage menstruation amid food insecurity, inadequate water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), disrupted education, gendered social norms and protection systems. These challenges are often addressed through separate humanitarian programmes, obscuring how they interact in girls everyday lives. This study explored menstrual-health experiences and perceived nutritional deprivation among adolescent girls in five IDP camps in Benue State, Nigeria. We conducted a focused ethnographic qualitative study in the International Market, Mega, Ortese, Uikpam, and Abagana camps. Twenty-five in-depth interviews with menstruating adolescent girls aged 13-19 years were complemented by focus group discussions with adolescent girls, adult women, adult men, and camp leaders, and structured WASH and food observations. Interviews and discussions were conducted in English, Tiv or both, transcribed verbatim and translated where necessary. Data were managed in MAXQDA and analysed using reflexive thematic analysis. Frequencies describe the distribution of 435 coded excerpts and are not participant prevalence estimates. Six themes and 20 subthemes were generated. Menstrual-health management and material constraints accounted for 95 coded excerpts (21.8%), followed by knowledge and lived experience (80; 18.4%), food insecurity and perceived nutritional deprivation (70; 16.1%), coping and adaptive agency (70; 16.1%), sociocultural beliefs and taboos (65; 14.9%), and self-reported symptoms and participation restrictions (55; 12.6%). Girls described irregular access to commercial pads, reliance on improvised materials, limited water and soap, and toilets that were unsafe or inaccessible at night. Dietary monotony, meal skipping, and hunger were perceived to intensify pain, weakness, and fatigue. Fear of staining, menstrual silence, and household restrictions contributed to withdrawal from school, livelihood, and domestic activities. Peer support was protective, but some girls undertook informal work to obtain menstrual materials, raising safeguarding concerns. Menstrual health in prolonged displacement is not an isolated hygiene issue but an outcome of interacting material, nutritional, sociocultural, educational, and protection constraints. Humanitarian responses should combine predictable access to acceptable menstrual materials with safe WASH facilities, adolescent-responsive food and nutrition support, confidential health services, community education and safeguarding mechanisms. Reported symptoms and nutritional experiences were not clinically measured.

items.title_zh: 尼日利亚本内州内部流离失所者营地青少年女孩的月经健康与食品不安全研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于生活在尼日利亚本内州五个内部流离失所者（IDP）营地的青少年女孩，探讨她们在食品不安全、缺乏水、卫生和健康（WASH）、教育中断及性别社会规范等背景下的月经健康管理和营养缺乏感。研究采用定性聚焦人种志方法，进行25次深入访谈，参与者为13-19岁的月经期青少年女孩，并辅以小组讨论和结构化的WASH及食品观察。数据通过MAXQDA管理，采用反思性主题分析。研究生成六个主题和20个子主题，其中月经健康管理和物质限制占95个编码摘录（21.8%），知识与生活经验占80个（18.4%）。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，尼日利亚本内州内部流离失所者营地的青少年女孩在食品不安全和卫生条件差的环境中，面临严重的月经健康管理和营养缺乏问题。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于尼日利亚本内州五个内部流离失所者（IDP）营地中的青少年女孩，探讨她们在食品不安全、缺乏水、卫生和健康（WASH）、教育中断及性别社会规范等背景下的月经健康管理和营养缺乏感。研究采用定性聚焦人种志方法，进行了25次深入访谈，参与者为年龄在13至19岁之间的月经期青少年女孩，并辅以小组讨论和结构化的WASH及食品观察。数据通过MAXQDA软件进行管理，并采用反思性主题分析方法进行分析。

研究结果生成了六个主题和20个子主题，其中月经健康管理和物质限制占据了95个编码摘录（21.8%），而知识与生活经验则占据了80个编码摘录（18.4%）。这些数据表明，青少年女孩在月经健康管理方面面临着显著的挑战，尤其是在物质资源匮乏的情况下。食品不安全和缺乏基本的水、卫生与健康设施，严重影响了她们的月经健康管理能力。此外，教育中断和性别社会规范也加剧了她们在这一领域的困境。

研究强调了在内部流离失所者营地中，青少年女孩的月经健康管理不仅受限于物质条件，还受到社会文化因素的影响。这些发现为改善青少年女孩的月经健康管理提供了重要的见解，呼吁相关政策制定者和社会服务机构关注这一群体的特殊需求，以便提供更有效的支持和资源。通过深入了解这些女孩的经历和挑战，能够更好地制定针对性的干预措施，提升她们的生活质量和健康水平。

items.title: Planned care accounts for one in three recurrent hospitalizations in alcohol-related cirrhosis
items.abstract: Hospital readmission is used in cirrhosis research as if a return to hospital meant the disease had worsened: it is a trial outcome, a quality indicator and a prediction target. We asked what those readmissions were. Sixty-one adults with alcohol-related cirrhosis, selected because they had been hospitalized more than once, contributed all 326 later admissions to one department. A clinician read each full record and classified it for acute decompensation and for admission mode, blinded to diagnostic codes and structured flags. Fewer than two in five admissions (125, 38.3%) were decompensations. One in three (114) had been booked in advance; none of these was a decompensation, yet they used 29.1% of all bed-days. Among 124 returns within 30 days, planned admissions outnumbered decompensations, 48 to 43. Counting all admissions tracked a patients decompensations only moderately (correlation 0.50) whereas counting urgent admissions tracked them closely (0.93). In crude analysis the sicker patients had fewer admissions, not more, because planned care goes to those well enough to receive it. A liver severity score, computable for 165 admissions, did not separate planned from urgent admissions or decompensations from other stays, even within one patient. Readmission was not the same thing as decompensation.
items.authors: Mirowski, K.; Zmuda, A.; Herashchenko, H.; Slusarczyk, M.; Łukaszewska, D.; Balicka-Slusarczyk, B.; Hydzik, P.; Kukla, M.
items.title_zh: 计划性护理占酒精性肝硬化再入院的三分之一
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了酒精性肝硬化患者的再入院情况。研究对象为61名因多次住院而选定的成人，记录了326次后续入院。临床医生在不知诊断代码的情况下对每个病例进行了分类。结果显示，少于五分之二的入院（125次，38.3%）为急性失代偿。三分之一（114次）为提前预约入院，这些入院均非失代偿，且占用了29.1%的床位日。在124次30天内的回访中，计划性入院（48次）超过了失代偿（43次）。总入院次数与失代偿的相关性较低（0.50），而紧急入院的相关性较高（0.93）。分析显示，病情较重的患者入院次数反而较少，因计划性护理主要面向病情较轻的患者。肝脏严重度评分未能有效区分计划性入院与紧急入院或失代偿。再入院并不等同于失代偿。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，酒精性肝硬化患者的再入院中，计划性护理占三分之一，且与病情严重程度无明显相关性。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在探讨酒精性肝硬化患者的再入院情况，研究对象为61名因多次住院而选定的成人，记录了326次后续入院。研究发现，少于五分之二的入院（125次，38.3%）为急性失代偿（acute decompensation），而三分之一（114次）为提前预约入院，这些入院均非失代偿，且占用了29.1%的床位日。在124次30天内的回访中，计划性入院（planned admission）达48次，超过了失代偿的43次。总入院次数与失代偿的相关性较低（0.50），而紧急入院（emergency admission）的相关性则较高（0.93）。分析结果显示，病情较重的患者反而入院次数较少，这表明计划性护理主要面向病情较轻的患者。此外，肝脏严重度评分（liver severity score）未能有效区分计划性入院与紧急入院或失代偿。综上所述，再入院并不等同于失代偿，计划性护理在酒精性肝硬化患者的再入院中占据了重要地位，约占总入院的三分之一。此研究为临床实践提供了重要的见解，强调了对不同类型入院的关注和管理。

items.title: A Refined Lung Transplant Frailty Scale Incorporating Serum Albumin Is Associated With Risk of Mortality in Lung Transplant Candidates
items.abstract: Background: The Lung Transplant Frailty Scale (LT-FS) is a validated binary measure of frailty in lung transplant candidates. We aimed to refine the LT-FS Base and Body Composition measures by developing a three-category classification to improve clinical risk stratification with serum albumin as a more clinically practical frailty biomarker. Methods: To develop the refined LT-FS, we applied a 4-step measure development method to a multicenter prospective cohort study of lung transplant candidates. Low albumin (<3.5 g/dL) replaced high serum C-reactive protein ([ ]10 mg/L) as the LT-FS biomarker. Cutpoints that balanced discrimination, risk prediction, and calibration were identified to define ''frail'', ''pre-frail'', and ''not frail'' categories. Next, we evaluated associations between the refined LT-FS and exercise capacity, patient-reported outcomes, and mortality using multivariate linear and Cox regression. Results: Among 419 participants, the refined LT-FS identified a graded increase in mortality risk across frailty categories. For example, compared with candidates who were not frail, pre-frailty and frailty by the LT-FS Body Composition were associated with a 2.9-fold (HR 2.9, 95% CI 1.2-6.9) and 7-fold (HR 6.9, 95% CI 2.6-18.2) higher risk of waitlist delisting or death, respectively. Pre-frailty and frailty by LT-FS Body Composition were associated with 2-fold (HR 2.1, 95% CI 1.2-3.8) and 3.6-fold (HR 3.6, 95% CI 1.8-7.3) higher risk of mortality after transplant. Relationships with exercise capacity and patient-reported disability were less consistent. Conclusions: A refined Lung Transplant Frailty Scale incorporating serum albumin demonstrates strong associations with waitlist and post-transplant mortality. The addition of a pre-frail category better captures the continuum of frailty and improves clinical risk stratification of lung transplant candidates.

items.title_zh: 改进的肺移植虚弱评分与肺移植候选人死亡风险相关
items.summary_zh: 背景：肺移植虚弱评分（LT-FS）是评估肺移植候选人虚弱的有效二元指标。本研究旨在通过开发三类分类法，结合血清白蛋白，改进LT-FS基础和身体成分测量，以提高临床风险分层。方法：我们在多中心前瞻性队列研究中应用四步测量开发方法，低血清白蛋白（<3.5 g/dL）取代高血清C反应蛋白（≥10 mg/L）作为LT-FS生物标志物。确定了平衡区分度、风险预测和校准的切点，以定义“虚弱”、“前虚弱”和“非虚弱”类别。结果：在419名参与者中，改进的LT-FS显示出虚弱类别间死亡风险的逐级增加。与非虚弱候选人相比，LT-FS身体成分的前虚弱和虚弱分别与等待名单取消或死亡的风险增加2.9倍（HR 2.9, 95% CI 1.2-6.9）和7倍（HR 6.9, 95% CI 2.6-18.2）相关。
items.l1_lead: 改进的肺移植虚弱评分与肺移植候选人的死亡风险显著相关，前虚弱和虚弱状态分别使等待名单取消或死亡风险增加2.9倍和7倍。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在改进肺移植虚弱评分（LT-FS），以更准确地评估肺移植候选人的虚弱程度，并与死亡风险相关联。研究背景指出，LT-FS作为评估候选人虚弱的有效二元指标，亟需通过引入新的生物标志物和分类法来提升其临床风险分层能力。研究采用多中心前瞻性队列研究设计，实施了四步测量开发方法，重点将低血清白蛋白（<3.5 g/dL）作为LT-FS的新生物标志物，取代了高血清C反应蛋白（≥10 mg/L）。

在研究过程中，研究者确定了平衡区分度、风险预测和校准的切点，以定义“虚弱”、“前虚弱”和“非虚弱”三类候选人。结果显示，在419名参与者中，改进后的LT-FS能够有效地反映不同虚弱类别间的死亡风险逐级增加。具体而言，与非虚弱候选人相比，前虚弱候选人和虚弱候选人分别与等待名单取消或死亡的风险增加2.9倍（风险比HR 2.9, 95% CI 1.2-6.9）和7倍（HR 6.9, 95% CI 2.6-18.2）相关。

这一研究结果表明，改进的LT-FS不仅能够更好地识别肺移植候选人的虚弱状态，还能为临床提供更为精确的风险评估工具，从而有助于优化肺移植的决策过程和患者管理。通过引入低血清白蛋白作为关键生物标志物，研究为肺移植候选人的评估提供了新的视角，强调了身体成分在虚弱评估中的重要性。

items.title: The Bern Sleep-Wake Registry: A 25-year multimodal resource for data-driven sleep medicine
items.abstract: Background: Sleep-wake-circadian disorders are prevalent and contribute substantially to morbidity, mortality and reduced quality of life. Evaluation in real-world settings is essential to capture their complexity and association with long-term outcomes. Most sleep-wake registries are restricted to selected populations, lack systematic integration of objective sleep-wake-circadian assessments with the clinical data and provide limited follow-up. To address these limitations, we established the Bern Sleep-Wake Registry based on real-world data from a tertiary University Hospital sleep center. Methods: The registry includes data from patients referred to the multidisciplinary Sleep- Center at Inselspital, University Hospital Bern (funded in 1990), from the year 2000 onwards who underwent at least one objective assessment such as polysomnography, daytime sleep-wake recordings, vigilance tests, and actigraphy. The registry integrates clinical information, questionnaire scores, outputs of objective assessments and raw signal data, and is regularly updated to incorporate new patients and longitudinal follow-up information. Results: As of September 2025, records from over 11000 patients were evaluated (median age: 50 years (interquantile range 36, 61); 65% male). The most common sleep-wake-circadian disorders were sleep-related breathing disorders (67%), insomnia disorders (15%) and central disorders of hypersomnolence (9%). Available assessments included more than 12000 polysomnographies, 2400 multiple sleep latency tests, 2100 maintenance of wakefulness tests, 1800 vigilance tests and 4500 actigraphies. Conclusions: By longitudinally integrating multimodal deep clinical phenotyping with objective assessments and raw physiological signals, the Bern Sleep-Wake Registry provides a foundation for investigating disease trajectories, identifying novel biomarkers and developing data-driven approaches to precise diagnosis, prognosis and individualized treatment.
items.authors: van der Meer, J.; Filchenko, I.; Brill, A.-K.; Wenz, E.; Fregolente, L.; Zub, K.; Dietmann, A.; Schaefer, C.; Roethlisberger, S. C.; Helmy, A.; Tzovara, A.; Fiorillo, L.; Faraci, F. D.; Valenzuela, W.; Schindler, K. A.; Schmitt, W.; Schmidt, M. H.; Bassetti, C. L. A.
items.title_zh: 伯尔尼睡眠-觉醒登记：25年多模式数据驱动睡眠医学资源
items.summary_zh: 背景：睡眠-觉醒-昼夜节律障碍普遍存在，显著影响发病率、死亡率和生活质量。真实世界中的评估对于捕捉其复杂性及与长期结果的关联至关重要。大多数睡眠-觉醒登记局限于特定人群，缺乏系统整合客观睡眠-觉醒-昼夜节律评估与临床数据，且随访有限。为解决这些问题，我们建立了伯尔尼睡眠-觉醒登记，基于来自三级大学医院睡眠中心的真实世界数据。方法：该登记包括自2000年起转诊至伯尔尼大学医院Inselspital多学科睡眠中心的患者数据，这些患者至少接受过一次客观评估，如多导睡眠监测、白天睡眠-觉醒记录、警觉性测试和活动监测。登记整合了临床信息、问卷评分、客观评估结果和原始信号数据，并定期更新以纳入新患者及纵向随访信息。结果：截至2025年9月，评估了超过11000名患者的记录（中位年龄：50岁（四分位数范围36, 61）；65%为男性）。最常见的睡眠-觉醒-昼夜节律障碍为睡眠相关呼吸障碍（67%）、失眠障碍（15%）等。
items.l1_lead: 伯尔尼睡眠-觉醒登记通过整合真实世界数据，揭示了睡眠-觉醒-昼夜节律障碍的普遍性及其对健康的影响，为睡眠医学提供了重要资源。
items.l2_summary:
伯尔尼睡眠-觉醒登记（Bern Sleep-Wake Registry）是一个旨在解决睡眠-觉醒-昼夜节律障碍（sleep-wake circadian rhythm disorders）评估不足的问题的多模式数据驱动资源。睡眠-觉醒-昼夜节律障碍在现代社会中普遍存在，严重影响人们的发病率、死亡率和生活质量，因此对其进行真实世界中的评估显得尤为重要。然而，现有的睡眠-觉醒登记往往局限于特定人群，缺乏系统整合客观评估与临床数据的能力，并且随访时间有限。为此，伯尔尼大学医院Inselspital的多学科睡眠中心自2000年起建立了这一登记，收集了来自转诊患者的真实世界数据。

该登记涵盖了至少接受过一次客观评估的患者数据，这些评估包括多导睡眠监测（polysomnography）、白天睡眠-觉醒记录、警觉性测试和活动监测。登记系统整合了临床信息、问卷评分、客观评估结果以及原始信号数据，并定期更新以纳入新患者及其纵向随访信息。截至2025年9月，登记已评估超过11000名患者，患者的中位年龄为50岁（四分位数范围36至61岁），其中65%为男性。结果显示，最常见的睡眠-觉醒-昼夜节律障碍为睡眠相关呼吸障碍（占67%），其次是失眠障碍（占15%）等。

通过这一登记，研究者能够更全面地捕捉睡眠-觉醒-昼夜节律障碍的复杂性，并探讨其与长期健康结果之间的关联。这一资源的建立不仅为睡眠医学的研究提供了宝贵的数据支持，也为临床实践提供了更为系统化的评估工具，推动了睡眠医学领域的发展。

items.title: AI-Assisted Tissue-Based Antibody Interpretation in Autoimmune Encephalitis: Prospective Validation and Reader Study
items.abstract: Tissue-based assays provide broad screening for neural autoantibodies but remain vulnerable to technical and reader-dependent variability. We evaluated an integrated workflow combining automated 3,3'-diaminobenzidine tissue-based assay processing, digital whole-slide imaging, and interpretable deep learning. Model development used 2,357 retrospective serum and cerebrospinal fluid images referred from more than 80 institutions and processed in a centralized laboratory, with reference labels established by expert-consensus tissue-based assay interpretation. A prospective validation cohort included 200 images from 200 unique patients (154 positive and 46 negative; 100 serum and 100 cerebrospinal fluid). The same images were evaluated by two expert and two novice readers in a fixed-order two-round study, with unaided interpretation followed by artificial-intelligence-assisted interpretation after a washout of at least two weeks. The standalone binary classifier achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.922, accuracy of 86.5%, sensitivity of 85.7%, and specificity of 89.1% in prospective validation. Pooled reader accuracy was 90.4% in the unaided round and 97.4% in the artificial-intelligence-assisted round (McNemar P < 0.001), with specificity of 82.6% and 99.5%, respectively. Novice-reader accuracy was 83.3% unaided and 96.5% with artificial-intelligence assistance (P < 0.001), approaching unaided expert accuracy of 97.5%. Among tissue-based-assay-positive cases, reader accuracy for cytoplasmic/nuclear antigen-associated versus neural surface antigen-associated staining-pattern subclassification was 88.8% unaided and 94.0% with artificial-intelligence assistance (P < 0.001). These findings support further multicentre, cross-platform evaluation of artificial-intelligence-assisted neural autoantibody tissue interpretation.
items.authors: Cao, Z.; Xie, D.; Zou, S.; Li, D.; Martinez-Martinez, P.; Zong, S.; Zhang, Z.
items.title_zh: AI辅助的自身免疫性脑炎组织抗体解读研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了一种结合自动化3,3'-二氨基联苯胺组织检测、数字全切片成像和可解释深度学习的综合工作流程。模型开发使用了来自80多个机构的2,357幅回顾性血清和脑脊液图像，并在集中实验室处理，参考标签由专家共识的组织检测解读建立。前瞻性验证队列包括200幅来自200名独特患者的图像（154例阳性，46例阴性；100幅血清和100幅脑脊液）。两位专家和两位新手读者在固定顺序的两轮研究中评估相同图像，首次为无辅助解读，随后在至少两周的洗脱期后进行人工智能辅助解读。独立二分类器在前瞻性验证中获得了0.922的受试者工作特征曲线下面积，86.5%的准确率，85.7%的灵敏度和89.1%的特异性。无辅助解读的读者准确率为90.4%，人工智能辅助解读为97.4%（McNemar P < 0.001），特异性分别为82.6%和99.5%。新手读者的无辅助准确率为83.3%，人工智能辅助为96.5%。
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，AI辅助的解读显著提高了自身免疫性脑炎组织抗体检测的准确性和特异性，尤其对新手读者的帮助尤为明显。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在评估一种结合自动化3,3'-二氨基联苯胺（DAB）组织检测、数字全切片成像和可解释深度学习的综合工作流程，以解读自身免疫性脑炎的组织抗体。研究使用了来自80多个机构的2,357幅回顾性血清和脑脊液图像，所有图像在集中实验室处理，并依据专家共识建立的参考标签进行解读。为了验证模型的有效性，研究还设计了一个前瞻性验证队列，包括200幅来自200名独特患者的图像，其中154例为阳性，46例为阴性，样本中包含100幅血清和100幅脑脊液。

在评估过程中，两位专家和两位新手读者对相同图像进行了两轮研究，首次为无辅助解读，随后在至少两周的洗脱期后进行人工智能（AI）辅助解读。研究结果显示，独立二分类器在前瞻性验证中获得了0.922的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC），准确率为86.5%，灵敏度为85.7%，特异性为89.1%。在无辅助解读的情况下，读者的准确率为90.4%，而在AI辅助解读后，准确率提升至97.4%（McNemar P < 0.001），特异性分别为82.6%和99.5%。对于新手读者而言，无辅助解读的准确率为83.3%，而在AI辅助下准确率提升至96.5%。

综上所述，本研究表明，AI辅助的解读方法显著提高了自身免疫性脑炎组织抗体的检测准确性，尤其是在新手读者中，显示出AI技术在医学影像解读中的潜在应用价值。

items.title: Prospective validation of an uncertainty-aware machine learning model for secondary progressive multiple sclerosis classification
items.abstract: Background: Relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) often progresses to secondary-progressive MS (SPMS), but diagnosis is typically retrospective, delaying potential interventions. Existing rule-based and machine learning approaches often lack prospective validation and provide no uncertainty estimates, limiting clinical adoption. Objective: To prospectively evaluate a conformal prediction (CP)-enabled random forest model for reproducing clinician-recorded disease course labels in the Swedish Multiple Sclerosis Registry (SMSReg) and compare its classifications with the Lorscheider criteria. Methods: The CP model was trained and calibrated on SMSReg-2022 (10,787 individuals, 85,461 hospital visits) and then validated on SMSReg-2025 (15,719 individuals, 45,077 hospital visits; not included in the SMSReg-2022 training/calibration/testing datasets). Performance was assessed at the hospital visit and individual levels and compared with the Lorscheider criteria. Results: The model maintained good calibration on the prospective dataset. At the per-hospital visit-level, the model accuracies were 92% (RRMS) and 95% (SPMS). At the individual level, sensitivity was 98%, specificity 89%, and F1-score 0.75. With clinician-recorded labels as reference, the model showed higher sensitivity than the Lorscheider criteria (98% vs. 71%), more transition assignments (90% vs. 57%), and higher F1-score (0.76 vs. 0.69). Conclusion: The CP-enabled model prospectively reproduced clinician-recorded disease course labels with calibrated uncertainty, supporting harmonization and decision support.
items.authors: Parakkal Sreenivasan, A.; Noui, Y.; Erngren, I.; Spjuth, O.; Burman, J.; Kultima, K.
items.title_zh: 前瞻性验证不确定性感知机器学习模型用于继发性进展型多发性硬化症分类
items.summary_zh: 背景：复发-缓解型多发性硬化症（RRMS）常进展为继发性进展型多发性硬化症（SPMS），但诊断通常为回顾性，延误潜在干预。现有的基于规则和机器学习的方法往往缺乏前瞻性验证且未提供不确定性估计，限制了临床应用。目的：前瞻性评估一种启用保形预测（CP）的随机森林模型，以重现瑞典多发性硬化症登记处（SMSReg）中临床医生记录的疾病进程标签，并与Lorscheider标准进行比较。方法：CP模型在SMSReg-2022（10,787人，85,461次就诊）上训练和校准，然后在SMSReg-2025（15,719人，45,077次就诊）上验证。结果：模型在前瞻性数据集上保持良好的校准。在每次就诊层面，模型准确率为92%（RRMS）和95%（SPMS）；在个体层面，灵敏度为98%，特异性为89%，F1分数为0.75。与临床医生记录的标签相比，模型的灵敏度高于Lorscheider标准（98%对71%），转变分配更多（90%对57%）。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，前瞻性验证的机器学习模型在继发性进展型多发性硬化症分类中表现出高灵敏度和准确性，优于传统临床标准。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在前瞻性地验证一种启用保形预测（Conformal Prediction, CP）的随机森林模型，用于分类继发性进展型多发性硬化症（SPMS），以解决当前复发-缓解型多发性硬化症（RRMS）向SPMS进展的诊断延误问题。传统的诊断方法多为回顾性，且现有的基于规则和机器学习的方法缺乏前瞻性验证和不确定性估计，限制了其在临床中的应用。研究利用瑞典多发性硬化症登记处（SMSReg）中的数据进行模型训练和验证，具体而言，CP模型在SMSReg-2022（包含10,787人，85,461次就诊）上进行训练和校准，并在SMSReg-2025（包含15,719人，45,077次就诊）上进行验证。

结果显示，该模型在前瞻性数据集上保持了良好的校准。在每次就诊层面，模型对RRMS的准确率为92%，对SPMS的准确率为95%；在个体层面，模型的灵敏度达到了98%，特异性为89%，F1分数为0.75。与临床医生记录的标签相比，模型的灵敏度显著高于Lorscheider标准（98%对71%），并且在疾病转变的分配上也表现出更高的准确性（90%对57%）。这些结果表明，CP模型在分类SPMS方面具有较高的准确性和可靠性，能够为临床医生提供更为有效的决策支持，从而有助于及时干预和改善患者的预后。

items.title: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
items.abstract: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable. However, evidence accumulated over the last decade points to an overall failure of this objective, instead promoting overreliance on incorrect predictions, which can subsequently lead to algorithmic aversion. Rather, XAI appears to function primarily as a debugging tool, useful for obtaining anecdotal insights into, for example, features learned by the model. One of the main issues underlying this limitation is that XAI methods often oversimplify the inner workings of the model, resulting in misalignment between the explanation and the model itself - a behavior referred to as unfaithfulness or infidelity. Faithfulness can be interpreted as the degree of approximation between an explanation and the model. Computing faithfulness in a rigorous manner would thus make it possible to quantify one of the various elements of trustworthiness of an explanation. However, existing metrics present significant limitations, making this quantification either infeasible or computationally expensive. In this position paper, we outline five major shortcomings of current faithfulness metrics and propose four possible avenues for research to bolster their reliability.
items.authors: Marco Zullich, Emily Schiller, Ivan Gentile, David Dembinsky, Adriano Lucieri, Kilian G\"oller, Steffen Seitz

items.title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
items.abstract: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. BipedalWalker-v3 and CarRacing-v3 improved without reaching their reporting targets. Six of ten Acrobot-v1 searches declined on held-out episodes, and the median paired change was negative. The results document improvement during program search and the transfer of selected-winner gains to new episodes in some tasks. Comparisons and ablations are needed to establish EliteTable's relative performance and the contributions of its components.
items.authors: Stuart Farmer

items.title: Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study
items.abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. All arms receive an identical budget - the same number of candidate schedules built and evaluated: an MCTS scheduling method, preregistered as the main arm; a randomized-restart list scheduler with no search tree as the control; and a textbook-UCT MCTS arm as a registered follow-up on the same domain. The analysis plan was locked before data collection; an independent checker confirmed all 768 confirmation-stage schedules valid with correct finish times. At the main budget of 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than the restarts (95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]; the 72 of 96 held-out instances with positive baseline-relative headroom). The deficit is not budget starvation: on the separate exploration pool restarts self-improve by 1.85% where MCTS gains 0.24%, and 700 of 720 of MCTS's first results are merely the warm start it was handed. The studied selection rule locks deterministically onto the first-expanded child, keeping its trials correlated while restarts draw gains from the tails; the causal link to makespan remains an inference. A structural map locates where the tree stops paying: restarts win on sparse irregular workflows, no difference is detectable on regular layered ones, and dense ones leave no room to improve. Swapping the rule for textbook UCT removes most of the deficit (-0.26%, 95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]) without reversing its sign. Results are confined to a controlled synthetic domain (N in {8,16,32} tasks, 2-8 processors, budgets up to 2048); we make no claim about larger budgets.
items.authors: Yuyu Zhang

items.title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
items.abstract: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on $\tau^2$-Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.
items.authors: Wei Yang, Qing Ping, Youzhi Luo, Yawei Wang, Abhishek Kumar, Panpan Xu, Jun Huan

items.title: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire
items.abstract: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game's highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger. A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that part of their performance rests on prior knowledge of the game, and models do not improve from the memories they write across runs, which are often wrong and overly cautious. Our harness is the first to give a model the complete original game, and we compare it with existing harnesses. Overall, SpireBench offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark with tools to locate where and why agents fail.
items.authors: Scott C. Lowe, Sander W. Keemink

items.title: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
items.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality. We investigate whether the current policy can judge its own trajectories and use these judgments to improve task performance without a separately trained reward model. To this end, we introduce Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), a reward-refinement method that reuses the policy to compare observable debugging behavior among trajectories from the same task with the same verifier outcome. BSR aggregates pairwise preferences into task-local scores and converts them into bounded auxiliary rewards, introducing reward contrast while preserving the verifier-defined pass/fail ordering. This provides additional supervision from already-collected trajectories without requiring new environment interactions. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench-Live show consistent improvements across the evaluated Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B configurations, supporting using the policy's own comparative judgments as a complementary learning signal for training software engineering agents.
items.authors: Yiran Wu, Andrew Zhao, Yurui Chang, Qingyun Wu, Xuan Feng

items.title: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
items.abstract: LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification. Yet clarification is useful only when the agent can turn the answer into better decisions. As training changes how the agent handles incomplete information and uses additional answers, the same clarification can become more or less useful. We introduce CLEAT (CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-Training), a framework that co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy from shared interaction outcomes. We formulate residual query value to measure the task utility gained by asking rather than proceeding under the current policy, and estimate it through paired rollouts from the same interaction history. These paired returns train the controller to predict clarification value and the task policy to select useful questions and act on the answers. The controller guides subsequent rollout collection, while outcomes from the updated agent provide new value labels that allow clarification guidance to adapt as the agent learns. With Qwen3-4B, CLEAT achieves the highest mean score in all ten evaluation settings across four benchmarks. Gains over the strongest baseline reach 13.2 and 6.5 percentage points on UserGym Travel and IN3 underspecification judgment accuracy, respectively. Ablations show that co-training improves the task policy even when the controller is removed at inference, while adapting clarification guidance to the evolving policy yields further gains.
items.authors: Jiatan Huang, Zheyuan Zhang, Ziming Li, Tianyi Ma, Mingchen Li, Yanfang Ye, Chuxu Zhang

items.title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
items.abstract: Data-centric scaling of RLVR has focused on collecting or generating verifiable training problems. However, corpus size alone does not determine whether the dataset provides a useful learning signal for a target policy. To guide the synthesis of effective RLVR data, we experimentally characterize dataset effectiveness as a function of its problems, the target policy, and the training rollout budget. Under this characterization, we show that a large open-source math corpus pooled from widely used RLVR datasets falls almost entirely into a zero-advantage trap: for a fixed target policy and rollout budget, roughly 88% of its problems are solved in every rollout or failed in every rollout. Filtering concentrates what remains, but it can only select, discarding the hard problems. Effective synthetic problems should therefore require the reasoning operations and compositions required to solve those hard problems. Yet their difficulty must be calibrated, so that some rollouts succeed, some fail, and at least one correct solution fits within the training budget. Prompting a teacher to vary hard problems directly does not achieve this. Guided by these empirical principles, we introduce MagicBeanStalk, a top-down decomposition and bottom-up recursive data-synthesis algorithm that grows seed problems into families of substantively new, policy- and budget-calibrated training problems while preserving the seeds' reasoning blueprints. Across 8 math benchmarks, continual RLVR on MagicBeanStalk problems improves gpt-oss-120b from 61.2 to 69.8 (+8.6) and DeepSeek v4Flash from 72.4 to 77.9 (+5.4) on a 16K-token budget. Training on the full 78K source corpus improves by only +1.1 and its best filtered real data subset by +5.8. In finance, we synthesize over 14K verifiable problems from only 340 solutions and improve over base by 6.9 and 2.4 points on SecQue and FinanceBench, respectively.
items.authors: Ximing Lu, Aviral Kumar, Jan Kautz, Yejin Choi, David Acuna

items.title: Faithful and Complete LLM-Assisted Automated Construction of Hierarchical Hardware Knowledge Graphs
items.abstract: Hardware datasheets contain engineering specifications essential for component selection, system integration, and hardware compatibility verification. However, manual inspection is tedious and error-prone because datasheets are lengthy and heterogeneous, with dense information fragmented across tables, figures, and text. Although large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, na\"ive one-shot processing omits relevant specifications even when the document fits within the model's context window. We present an automated LLM-driven pipeline that transforms hardware datasheets into general-purpose hierarchical hardware knowledge graphs through chunk-based property extraction, hierarchical routing, and iterative refinement. The framework uses LLMs for information extraction and semantic reasoning while preserving source provenance and applying graph updates through validated instructions and deterministic local execution. This staged design reduces per-query context and maintains traceable intermediate representations. The resulting knowledge graphs provide semantically organized, source-grounded hardware properties for downstream retrieval and reasoning. We evaluate the framework on 20 hardware datasheets spanning diverse component types and document lengths. We assess property faithfulness and introduce inter-graph completeness to measure relative semantic coverage without exhaustive ground truth. Our framework achieves 98.8% property faithfulness compared with 76.1% for the one-shot baseline, while fully covering 83.6% of faithful baseline properties; in the reverse direction, the baseline fully covers only 10.5% of ours. These improvements provide more reliable and comprehensive engineering information for downstream hardware design and verification, reducing the risk of overlooked constraints and incorrect decisions.
items.authors: Haotian Qiao, Robert P. Dick

items.title: Representation Alignment from a Few Paired Data via Distilled Optimal Transport
items.abstract: Aligning two independently pretrained unimodal encoders typically demands millions of paired examples. In this paper, we study the regime where only $N \sim 100$--$500$ pairs are available, while unpaired data on either side is abundant. Our method expresses every representation by its similarities to the $N$ paired anchors, which places both modalities in a common coordinate system; matches the two point clouds with a single entropic optimal transport problem solved over the entire pool, whose marginal constraints counteract the hubness that defeats nearest-neighbor matching; and distills the resulting plan into two lightweight encoders, so that the correspondence becomes inductive. We additionally put this marginal constraint in relation with the one-step hub corrections of the bilingual lexicon induction literature. Pairing is required only for the anchors: the unpaired collections may be drawn independently from the two marginals, so that no item outside the anchor set needs to have both of its modalities observed. We evaluate on image-text and molecule-text alignment, where our method outperforms existing approaches at the same anchor budget on Flickr30k, MS-COCO and ChEBI-20.
items.authors: Julien Kordes, Reuben Dorent

items.title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
items.abstract: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. Yet even procedurally capable agents can fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated. We study a complementary axis of self-evolution: evolving those beliefs during deployment. Such beliefs can support multiple tasks, but incorrect ones can also propagate across them. We introduce EvoBelief, a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses. Unexpected outcomes and decision-relevant unknowns trigger hypothesis formation. Later observations and controlled experiments provide independent validation before a rule can guide predictions or plans within its supported scope. Counterexamples narrow or retire rules as the environment changes. The language model remains frozen, and each rule remains linked to its evidence and the decisions it changes. Across four benchmarks spanning static dynamics, hidden drift, and scientific discovery, EvoBelief improves task performance and reuses learned rules across tasks. On ALFWorld without actor-side transition memory, it improves success over the matched Frozen World Model by 23.9% and 31.3% with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4, respectively. On MiniGrid, it revises stale rules and recovers after unannounced dynamics changes. In DiscoveryWorld's Reactor Lab, it discovers and validates quantitative laws, completing 83.3% of Normal-tier and 58.3% of Challenge-tier instances, versus 0% for each evaluated baseline. These results demonstrate self-improvement through testable, revisable environment knowledge rather than model-parameter updates.
items.authors: Janet Wang, Jiang Guo, Yi Xiang, Jiaqing Yuan, Mingwen Dong, Hideo Kobayashi, Shuaichen Chang, Chandan K. Reddy, Jiarong Jiang

items.title: VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails
items.abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. Runtime guardrails should therefore make inspectable, reproducible, and deterministic allow or refuse decisions before potentially irreversible agent actions are executed. However, safety and security requirements are rarely complete before deployment, so guardrails need to keep adapting as new risks emerge. Existing adaptive guardrails learn from deployment experience, but they usually apply safety policies through LLM inference, which can lead to inconsistent decisions and ambiguous policy interpretations. Formal guardrails, on the other hand, enforce policies deterministically, but they usually rely on pre-deployment or task-specific policies and have no mechanism to adapt to newly observed risks. We introduce VEPA, a framework for the verified evolution of formal agent guardrails. VEPA represents the guardrail as a formal policy of executable symbolic rules over typed agent events. During deployment, we use an LLM guided by deployment feedback to propose policy patches that fix newly observed failures while preserving previously correct behavior. Then, a deterministic verifier only accepts policies that are structurally valid and conflict-free. Finally, an evidence-aware authority layer activates a verified rule only when it has enough supporting evidence, so uncertain updates cannot directly affect guardrail decisions. Across ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench, VEPA consistently outperforms baselines while expanding the scope of deterministic formal-policy enforcement. These gains also hold under more challenging deployment conditions, including mixed streams, corrupted feedback, and longer horizons.
items.authors: Duy Nguyen, Lesly Miculicich, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Shuo Li, Krishnamurthy Dj Dvijotham, Mohit Bansal, Tomas Pfister, Long T. Le

items.title: Reward Hacking as a Transmissible Strategy in Multi-Agent Coding Systems
items.abstract: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used to solve coding tasks by coordinating agents that share code and plans. These agents are often optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) using automated evaluators, but bypassing evaluation can earn reward without producing a genuine solution. Prior work has largely treated reward hacking as a single-agent failure. In this work, we show that a reward-hacking strategy elicited in one agent can propagate to others and affect system coordination. Across four open-weight backbones, coding RL elicits and amplifies reward hacking in two settings: explicit mechanism descriptions in the system prompt and mid-training that models upstream exposure to facts about the coding environment. Using post-RL agents from the mid-training setting as sources, we observe propagation through code and shared memory, and across roles through natural-language plans. Even agents based on small open-weight models induce reward hacking in stronger closed-weight targets. On hard tasks, propagation can intensify along a transmission chain after the original source leaves as the code acquires more persuasive justifications. We also theoretically analyze conditions under which reward hacking amplifies, persists, or decays across agent interactions. Beyond propagation, reward hacking can bias task routing toward reward-hacking agents and survive candidate aggregation. As potential mitigations, we evaluate code review by the coder or a separate verifier, both of which reduce delivered hacks. Together, these results establish reward hacking as a transmissible strategy whose effects extend beyond the agent in which it first emerges.
items.authors: Yuepeng Hu, Pegah Ghahremani, Reza Aghajani, Mahesh Pasupuleti, Himaghna Bhattacharjee

items.title: Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest
items.abstract: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization. We challenge this conclusion by introducing a formally nested hierarchy of modularity: unit-level, which requires distinct computations to occupy disjoint neurons; orthogonal, which asks whether a rotation reveals functionally independent subspaces; and linear, which asks whether a bounded linear map can separate task-relevant computations into independent subspaces. We develop a unified framework for learning decompositions at each level and evaluating them causally through selective ablation. Across vision models, language models and multi-task Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), we find that networks which lack unit-level modularity nonetheless often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level. In vision and language models, content versus style and syntax versus semantics respectively dissociate under subspace ablation despite sharing overlapping populations of neurons. These learned subspaces also align differentially with brain data, with content and style subspaces predicting higher and lower visual cortex respectively, and semantic subspaces outperforming syntactic ones in predicting language cortex activity. In RNNs trained on multiple cognitive tasks and previously shown to lack modular structure, our decomposition recovers sharp double dissociations between tasks. The absence of unit-level modularity frequently coexists with clear subspace-level modularity across domains, enabling targeted intervention on specific computations even in networks where no individual neuron is specialized, with broad implications for mechanistic interpretability and for understanding functional organization in both biological and artificial neural systems.
items.authors: Shreya Saha, Benjamin Bergen, Meenakshi Khosla

items.title: Towards Defining, Measuring, and Leveraging Creativity in AI Applications
items.abstract: Despite extensive research, computational creativity still lacks a conceptually grounded, practically relevant, and empirically applicable formal definition across contexts such as art, scientific research, and games. Existing approaches to creativity often focus on proposing informal conceptual definitions without providing formal computational concepts. Alternatively, they propose formal definitions without carefully examining their underlying assumptions or providing validation of these definitions by testing their performance in specific application settings. To address these problems, this paper proposes several formal postulates of creativity grounded in prior psychological work on creativity, especially as related to Boden's three core criteria of creativity: newness, value, and surprise. Furthermore, we propose a conceptual mathematical definition of creativity that aligns with these postulates. We also validate our proposed creativity formula in two applications: determining the creativity of particular chess moves, and assessing the creativity of paintings by some artists, such as Picasso, Renoir, and other painters. Experimental results demonstrate that our formula of creativity successfully captures creative patterns across both the chess and the art domains. This suggests that creativity can be effectively characterized through a unified mathematical structure based on three fundamental criteria, namely newness, value, and surprise, whose specific measurements are adapted to the particular domains.
items.authors: Jingyi Yang, Alexander Tuzhilin

items.title: Mitigating Capability Degradation in LLM Self-Improvement via Representation Geometry Regularization
items.abstract: On-Policy Self-distillation is a self-improvement paradigm that enables large language models (LLMs) to improve their capabilities by leveraging the same model as both teacher and student under different conditioning contexts. However, we find that OPSD methods can progressively degrade previously acquired capabilities: queries that are correctly responded at earlier training stages may become incorrectly responded as optimization proceeds, even the overall performance continues to improve. Further analysis reveals that this degradation coincides with a deterioration of the geometry of hidden representations, characterized by reduced intra-cluster compactness and diminished inter-cluster separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose Representation Geometry Regularization (RGR), which preserves representation geometry during post-training by encouraging compactness within cluster and separation across cluster. RGR can be seamlessly integrated into existing OPSD methods without altering their core optimization procedures. Extensive experiments on multiple OPSD methods and benchmarks show that RGR generally alleviates capability degradation while retaining capability improvements. Our code is available in https://github.com/supermachinelearner/RGR.
items.authors: Jiaqi Tian, Ting Long

items.title: Collaborative Theory of Mind: Learning to Self-Revise by Anticipating User Responses
items.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong individual task performance, yet still struggle to collaborate with users over extended, multi-turn interactions, for example by attempting solutions before understanding the user's needs or by failing to revise mistaken assumptions after receiving feedback. We propose Collaborative Theory of Mind (CToM), a framework that addresses these challenges by explicitly training LLMs to anticipate user responses and to use those predictions to improve their own behavior. CToM drafts a response, predicts how the user will respond, and uses this prediction to guide internal revision before presenting a response. During training, the user's reply to each draft serves as the target for predicting the next turn, and we train the assistant to minimize the negative log-likelihood of that reply. We combine this prediction objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to optimize both task performance and interaction efficiency. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, and writing tasks, CToM achieves higher collaborative task performance than all baselines; for example, on a collaborative mathematical reasoning task, it improves final accuracy from 74.1% to 79.6% compared with naive GRPO. Ablations show that predicting user responses also makes collaboration more efficient: under the same reward, adding prediction supervision reduces the number of user replies by 8% on coding and 17% on writing while improving task performance. Behavioral analyses of interaction trajectories show that user-response predictions become more accurate after training, and that more accurate predictions are associated with larger improvements in collaborative task performance through self-revision.
items.authors: Fanzhi Zeng, Anubrata Das, Maytal Saar-Tsechansky, Liu Leqi

items.title: One-Step Text Generation by Seq-Drifting
items.abstract: Diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but still require multiple sampling steps to produce high-quality text. In this paper, we investigate whether a model can learn to generate an entire sequence in a single forward pass. We propose Seq-Drifting, a framework that applies drifting to sequences of continuous token representations and directly learns a map from Gaussian noise to text. Unlike existing DLMs that derive the supervision at each position directly from the observed token in a training sequence, Seq-Drifting builds a drift field whose position-wise targets adapt to the current generated context. At each position, attraction guides each output toward a set of contextually plausible token representations, while repulsion discourages collapse across samples and repetition within sequences. The generator learns from this drift field during training and produces all tokens jointly in one pass at inference. Empirically, Seq-Drifting achieves a generative perplexity of 36.01 on LM1B in one step and performs competitively in both unconditional and conditional generation. Experiments on translation, summarization, and reasoning further demonstrate the applicability of the framework beyond open-ended generation. These results suggest that drifting over token sequences offers a promising path toward effective one-step text generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/jyliu-ai/Seq-Drifting.
items.authors: Jiayu Liu, Ruizhi Zhao, Tianyun Ji, Yee Whye Teh, Zhenya Huang, Ning Miao

items.title: Mind the Spatial Gap: A Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning and Constrained Spatial Editing
items.abstract: Understanding and manipulating spatial relations is fundamental to AI systems that reason about physical environments and construct grounded world models. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning rely predominantly on static question-answering (QA) over small-scale or synthetic scenes, rarely probing whether models can modify spatial configurations while satisfying explicit geometric constraints. We introduce GeoSpatialBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate an escalating progression of spatial cognition, ranging from spatial relation understanding and geometric reasoning to constrained spatial editing. Grounded in real-world urban data across six geographically diverse cities, GeoSpatialBench evaluates a comprehensive taxonomy of 28 topological, directional, metric, and ordering relations across structured GeoJSON and map image modalities, with ground-truth references and constraints verified via GIS operations. Our empirical evaluation across frontier MLLMs uncovers a stark spatial gap: structured GeoJSON consistently outperforms map images, with multimodal combinations offering no reliable gain over GeoJSON alone, and while models show reasonable competence on qualitative topological and ordering, performance drops on quantitative metric relations. Crucially, editing performance on ordering relations declines relative to QA, and most failed edits violate at least one specified spatial constraint. These results highlight a gap between passively recognizing spatial relations and actively manipulating geometric configurations. GeoSpatialBench provides an open, rigorous diagnostic testbed to benchmark these spatial limitations, laying essential empirical groundwork for physically grounded world models and embodied spatial AI.
items.authors: Zheng Ren, Yanning Wang, Ziheng Huang, Fei Huang, Shiqi Wang, Ziqian Ye, Yang Yue

items.title: OGPO: Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization for Recoverable Vision-Language-Action Models
items.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise in robotic manipulation, yet their post-training still predominantly relies on trajectory-level supervised imitation over robot demonstrations. While effective for learning feasible actions, this paradigm supervises policies to reproduce expert actions at each step, biasing them toward demonstration-specific action paths and providing limited guidance for recovering toward task-progress states once execution deviates from demonstrated trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose OGPO, an Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization framework for recoverable VLA post-training. Instead of treating offline demonstrations merely as step-wise action labels, OGPO adaptively relabels trajectories with semantic key states and constructs goal-conditioned process rewards to optimize the policy for reaching these task-progress states. In this way, OGPO shifts VLA post-training from trajectory-level action imitation to key-state reachability learning, enabling policies to acquire a more robust ability to complete goal states from feasible off-demonstration states without requiring additional online interaction. Experiments on LIBERO and MetaWorld show that OGPO consistently improves VLA policy performance over standard supervised fine-tuning. Moreover, evaluations on LIBERO-Plus and our proposed LIBERO-ReAct, a mid-execution perturbation benchmark, further demonstrate that OGPO achieves stronger robustness and goal-directed recoverability under distribution shifts and recoverable off-demonstration states.
items.authors: Xule Gao, Xi Wang, Zehua Zang, Rui Wang, Changwen Zheng, Chuxiong Sun

items.title: DeFiRank: Federated Pairwise Ranking for Governance in Decentralized Financial Networks
items.abstract: Existing governance approaches in decentralized financial networks rely on manual review processes conducted by human committees, which introduces subjective bias, creates a scalability bottleneck under high network volume, and fails to capture complex behavioural patterns and evolving network dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose \name, a federated learning-based pairwise ranking framework in which multiple institutions collaboratively train a ranking model without sharing their private transaction data. This collaborative learning enables the model to capture network-wide behavioural patterns that signify strong network participation and directly contribute to the network effect, including diversity of counterparties, usage of multiple applications, and frequency of transactions. The proposed system ranks providers based on the authenticity of their actions, promoting genuine contributors and demoting those exhibiting suspicious behaviour. We evaluate \name\ on a real-world blockchain transaction dataset.
